def add_environment_feedback_callbacks(app: NewsegsDash):
    """Bind the callbacks of the environmental feedback.

    The fetch callback is a background callback, so the app needs a background callback manager.

    Args:
        app: The Dash app.
    """
    @app.callback(
        Output(ec.FETCH_BUTTON_ID, 'disabled'),
        Output(ec.STATUS_ID, 'children'),
        Output(ec.STATUS_ID, 'color'),
        Output(ec.STATUS_ID, 'style'),
        Output(ec.CONTAINER_ID, 'className'),
        Output(ec.PENDING_INTERVAL_ID, 'disabled'),
        Output(ec.READY_ID, 'data'),

        Input('site-location', 'data'),
        Input(ec.FETCH_RESULT_ID, 'data'),
        Input(ec.PENDING_INTERVAL_ID, 'n_intervals'),
        Input(ec.FETCH_RUNNING_ID, 'data'),
        Input('active-project-id', 'data'),
        State('app-state', 'data'),
    )
    def update_environment_feedback_status(site_loc, fetch_result, n_intervals, fetch_running, active_project_id, app_state):
        source = registers.get_environment_data_source(_model_type(app_state))
        if source is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        logger.debug('Getting metamodel - Updating environmental feedback status')
        status = get_status(
            source,
            site_location(site_loc),
            focussed_metamodel(app.project_provider, active_project_id),
            json.loads(fetch_result) if fetch_result else None,
            fetch_requested = bool(fetch_running),
        )
        logger.debug('Environmental feedback status: %s', status.status)
        return (
            not status.can_fetch,
            status.message,
            status.colour,
            {'display': 'inline-block' if status.message else 'none'},
            'mt-3' + (f' {ec.STALE_CLASS}' if status.stale else ''),
            status.status != 'pending',
            status.ready,
        )

    @app.callback(
        Output(ec.FETCH_RESULT_ID, 'data'),

        Input(ec.FETCH_BUTTON_ID, 'n_clicks'),
        State('site-location', 'data'),
        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        State('app-state', 'data'),

        background = True,
        running = [
            (Output(ec.FETCH_SPINNER_ID, 'style'), {'display': 'inline-block'}, {'display': 'none'}),
            (Output(ec.FETCH_RUNNING_ID, 'data'), True, False),
        ],
        prevent_initial_call = True,
    )
    def fetch_site_environment_data(n_clicks, site_loc, active_project_id, app_state):
        source = registers.get_environment_data_source(_model_type(app_state))
        location = site_location(site_loc)
        if not n_clicks or source is None or location is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        metamodel = focussed_metamodel(app.project_provider, active_project_id)
        if metamodel is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        return json.dumps(fetch_environment_data(source, location, metamodel))

    @app.callback(
        Output({'type': ec.ITEM_TYPE, 'key': ALL}, 'children'),
        Output(ec.DRAWN_ID, 'data'),

        Input(ec.READY_ID, 'data'),
        Input(ec.SUMMARY_ID, 'n_clicks'),
        State(ec.DRAWN_ID, 'data'),
        State({'type': ec.ITEM_TYPE, 'key': ALL}, 'id'),
        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        State('app-state', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call = True,
    )
    def draw_environment_feedback(ready, summary_clicks, drawn, item_ids, active_project_id, app_state):
        # Nothing is drawn while the Details is closed (an even count of clicks on its Summary),
        # or for a site whose data are not ready; the feedback of the previous site stays,
        # flagged as stale
        details_open = bool(summary_clicks) and summary_clicks % 2 == 1
        if not details_open or not ready or ready == drawn or not item_ids:
            raise PreventUpdate
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        location = location_from_key(json.loads(ready)['site'])
        logger.debug('Getting metamodel - Drawing environmental feedback')
        metamodel = focussed_metamodel(app.project_provider, active_project_id)
        if metamodel is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        lproj = app.project_provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
        sites = other_sites(lproj, location)
        children = draw_items(item_ids, _model_type(app_state), location, sites, metamodel)
        logger.info('Environmental feedback drawn in %.3fs', time.perf_counter() - t0)
        return children, ready

The input section headers to redraw for the triggers of their callback, and whether to rebuild the inputs.

A change of layout or of the active project (a string id) redraws every header and rebuilds every input container. Otherwise, each configuration update trigger redraws the header of its section, if the page has one (not every section has, e.g. those of optimisation). These triggers fire with no value after the containers are hydrated, which is ignored. Every trigger is considered, as several may fire together.

def input_headers_to_update(
    triggers: list[callback_utils.Trigger],
    header_ids: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], bool]:
    """The input section headers to redraw for the triggers of their callback, and whether to rebuild the inputs.

    A change of layout or of the active project (a string id) redraws every header and rebuilds every input
    container. Otherwise, each configuration update trigger redraws the header of its section, if the page has one
    (not every section has, e.g. those of optimisation). These triggers fire with no value after the containers are
    hydrated, which is ignored. Every trigger is considered, as several may fire together.

    Args:
        triggers: The triggers of the callback.
        header_ids: The ids of the headers on the page.

    Returns:
        The ids of the headers to redraw, in the order of `header_ids`, and whether to rebuild the input containers.
    """
    if any(not x.is_pattern() for x in triggers):
        return list(header_ids), True
    sections = {
        (x.id.get('supersection'), x.id.get('section')) for x in triggers # pyright: ignore[reportAttributeAccessIssue]
        if x.value is not None
    }
    return [x for x in header_ids if (x.get('supersection'), x.get('section')) in sections], False

def add_input_container_callbacks(app: NewsegsDash):
    """
    Callbacks to populate input containers.

    An input container is identified by:
    {'type': 'input-container', 'supersection': 'XXX', 'section': 'XXX'}
    """

    @app.callback(
        output = dict(
            headers = Output(
                {'type': 'input-section-header', 'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL},
                'children'    
            ),
            input_container_triggers = Output(
                {'type': 'input-container-hydration-interval', 'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL},
                'n_intervals'
            ),
        ),
        inputs = dict(
            layout_update_trigger = Input('layout-update-trigger', 'data'),
            active_project_id = Input('active-project-id', 'data'),
            input_group_update_trigger = Input({
                'type': 'input-group-config-update-trigger', 
                'supersection': ALL, 'purpose': 'trigger',
                'section': ALL, 'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL,
                'parameter_index': ALL, 'vector_location': ALL
            }, 'data'),
        ),
        state  = dict(
            app_state = State('app-state', 'data')
        ),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def update_input_header_contents(
        active_project_id,
        app_state,
        **kwargs
    ):
        if active_project_id is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        id_roots, update_contents = input_headers_to_update(
            callback_utils.get_triggers(), [x['id'] for x in ctx.outputs_grouping['headers']]
        )
        if not id_roots:
            raise PreventUpdate

        rval = callback_utils.create_noupdate_return()

        app_state = json.loads(app_state) if app_state else {}
        model_type = app_state.get('model_type', 'default')

        for container_id in id_roots:
            supersection = container_id.get('supersection')
            section = container_id.get('section')

            if update_contents:
                # set the intervals count to 0
                trigger_id = copy.copy(container_id)
                trigger_id['type'] = 'input-container-hydration-interval'
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    trigger_id,
                    'n_intervals',
                    0,
                    rval
                )

            try:
                content_creator = get_input_section_header_content_creator(

    ):

        rval = callback_utils.create_noupdate_return()

        app_state = json.loads(app_state) if app_state else {}
        model_type = app_state.get('model_type', 'default')

        # Intervals are reset to 0 by update_input_header_contents and then tick to 1;
        # only hydrate on the tick, or each container is built twice
        triggers = [x for x in ctx.triggered if x['value'] == 1]
        if not triggers:

        for trig in triggers:
            trig = json.loads(trig['prop_id'].rsplit('.',1)[0])
            supersection = trig.get('supersection')
            section = trig.get('section')

            container_id = dict(
                type = 'input-container',
                supersection = supersection,
                section = section
            )

            def _not_found(creator_type):
                logger.exception('%s content creator not found for Container ID: %s', creator_type, container_id)

            try:
                content_creator = get_input_container_content_creator(
                    supersection, section, model_type
                )
                if content_creator is None:
                    _not_found('Input Container')
                else:
                    logger.debug(
                        'Creating Input Container contents using creator found for %s.%s.%s',
                        supersection, section, model_type
                    )
                    callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                        container_id,
                        'children',
                        content_creator(active_project_id, app.project_provider),
                        rval
                    )
            except KeyError as e:

        logger.info(f'Input Container(s) hydrated in {t1 - t0:.3f}s')

    def react_to_input_change(
        input_ids,
        header_ids,
        trigger_ids,

        active_project_id,
        app_state,
        **kwargs
    ):
        # Primary dispatch is on the purpose of the input
        trigger_id = ctx.triggered_id
        if trigger_id is None or active_project_id is None or len(ctx.triggered) > 1:
            raise PreventUpdate
        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        rval = callback_utils.create_noupdate_return()

        now = time.time_ns()

        logger.info(
            'Input change has triggered "react_to_input_change". Triggering object was %s and updated value is %s',
            ctx.triggered_id, callback_utils.get_triggered_value()
        )

        match trigger_id['purpose']:
            case 'bound-lower' | 'bound-upper' | 'plot-intervals':
                match trigger_id['supersection']:
                    case 'dsa':
                        logger.debug('Input change being handled as dsa bounds value change.')
                        new_val = callback_utils.get_triggered_value()

                        provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
                        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Handling DSA bounds value change')
                        lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
                        lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]
                        varid =  make_varid(**trigger_id)
                        varuid = lmm.variables.get(varid)
                        if not varuid:
                            raise PreventUpdate
                        var = provider.variable_provider.get_variable(varuid)

                        if set_dsa_bound(provider, lproj, var, trigger_id['purpose'], new_val):
                            _redraw_headers(rval, header_ids, varid, var, lmm.model.model_type)

                            # Update triggers
                            for idx, id in enumerate(trigger_ids):
                                match id['supersection']:
                                    case 'dsa':
                                        rval['trigger_data'][idx] = now
                            _signal_summary_refresh(rval, now)

                    case 'optim':
                        logger.debug('Input change being handled as optim bounds value or plot resolution change.')
                        new_val = callback_utils.get_triggered_value()

                        provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
                        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Handling optim bounds value change')
                        lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
                        lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]
                        varid = make_varid(**trigger_id)
                        varuid = lmm.variables.get(varid)
                        if not varuid:
                            raise PreventUpdate
                        var = provider.variable_provider.get_variable(varuid)

                        match trigger_id['purpose']:
                            case 'plot-intervals':
                                # An emptied input leaves the resolution as it was
                                if new_val is None or int(new_val) == var.optim_plot_intervals:
                                    raise PreventUpdate
                                var.optim_plot_intervals = int(new_val)
                            case 'bound-lower':
                                # An emptied input unsets the bound, which falls back to the input limit
                                if new_val == var.optim_min:
                                    raise PreventUpdate
                                var.optim_min = new_val
                            case _:
                                if new_val == var.optim_max:
                                    raise PreventUpdate
                                var.optim_max = new_val

                        provider.variable_provider.upsert_variable(var)
                        provider.invalidate_cache_for_component(lproj.id)
                        # The settings are read by the optimisation and the marginal plot, in the workers
                        provider.touch_project(lproj.id)

                        # Plot intervals only set the resolution of the marginal plot
                        if trigger_id['purpose'] != 'plot-intervals':
                            # Configurations sharing the variable share its bounds
                            db_staleness.mark_inputs_changed(
                                staleness.metamodels_using_variable(lproj, varuid), 'optim'
                            )
                            for idx, id in enumerate(trigger_ids):
                                if id['supersection'] == 'optim':
                                    rval['trigger_data'][idx] = now

            case 'dsaboundtype':
                logger.debug('Input change being handled as dsa bounds type change.')
                new_val = callback_utils.get_triggered_value()

                provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
                logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Handling DSA bounds type change')
                lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
                lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]
                varid =  make_varid(**trigger_id)
                varuid = lmm.variables.get(varid)
                if not varuid:
                    raise PreventUpdate
                var = provider.variable_provider.get_variable(varuid)
                if not var or not set_dsa_bound_type(provider, lproj, var, new_val):
                    raise PreventUpdate

                # Update inputs
                for idx, id in enumerate(input_ids):
                    if id['supersection'] != 'dsa':
                        continue
                    if id['purpose'] == 'bound-lower':
                        rval['input_values'][idx] = var.dsa_lower
                    if id['purpose'] == 'bound-upper':
                        rval['input_values'][idx] = var.dsa_upper

                _redraw_headers(rval, header_ids, varid, var, lmm.model.model_type)

                # Update triggers with a dictionary, not an integer
                trig_val = json.dumps({
                    'message': 'dsa_bounds_modified',
                    'time': now
                })
                for idx, id in enumerate(trigger_ids):
                    match id['supersection']:
                        case 'dsa':
                            rval['trigger_data'][idx] = trig_val
                _signal_summary_refresh(rval, now)

            case 'dsa-active':
                logger.debug('Input change being handled as dsa active toggle change.')
                new_val = callback_utils.get_triggered_value()
                provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
                logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Handling DSA active status change')
                lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
                lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]
                varid =  make_varid(**trigger_id)
                varuid = lmm.variables.get(varid)
                if not varuid:
                    raise PreventUpdate
                var = provider.variable_provider.get_variable(varuid)
                if not var or new_val == var.dsa_selected:
                    raise PreventUpdate

                var.dsa_selected = new_val

                # Update triggers with a dictionary, not an integer
                trig_val = json.dumps({
                    'message': 'dsa_selection_status_modified',
                    'time': now
                })
                for idx, id in enumerate(trigger_ids):
                    match id['supersection']:
                        case 'dsa':
                            rval['trigger_data'][idx] = trig_val

                # Sync variable and invalidate tables
                provider.variable_provider.upsert_variable(var)

                # Sync the selection onto the independent instances of the variable in the other metamodels,
                # so that a whole-project DSA varies the same variables in every metamodel
                changed_mm_ids = list(staleness.metamodels_using_variable(lproj, varuid))
                for other_lmm in lproj.metamodels:
                    other_varuid = other_lmm.variables.get(varid)
                    if not other_varuid or other_varuid == varuid:
                        continue
                    other_var = provider.variable_provider.get_variable(other_varuid)
                    if (
                        not other_var
                        or not (other_var.dsa_possible and other_var.dsa_selectable)
                        or other_var.dsa_selected == new_val
                    ):
                        continue
                    other_var.dsa_selected = new_val
                    provider.variable_provider.upsert_variable(other_var)
                    for mm_id in staleness.metamodels_using_variable(lproj, other_varuid):
                        if mm_id not in changed_mm_ids:
                            changed_mm_ids.append(mm_id)

                provider.increment_revision(lproj.id)
                provider._component_provider.increment_revision(
                    lproj.table_config.id
                )
                db_staleness.mark_inputs_changed(changed_mm_ids, 'dsa')

            case _:
                try:
                    handler = get_input_handler(trigger_id['purpose'], trigger_id['type'], json.loads(app_state).get('model_type', 'default'))
                except KeyError:
                    logger.exception('No input handlers found for purpose: %s', trigger_id['purpose'])
                    raise PreventUpdate
                if handler:
                    logger.debug(
                        'Input change being handled by input handler registered to purpose: %s; and type: %s; for model type: %s;',
                        trigger_id['purpose'], trigger_id['type'], json.loads(app_state).get('model_type', 'default')
                    )
                    rval = handler(
                        trigger_id,
                        input_ids,
                        header_ids,
                        trigger_ids,
                        {**kwargs, 'app_state': app_state},
                        active_project_id,
                        app.project_provider,
                        return_dict = rval
                    )
                else:
                    logger.exception('No input handlers found for purpose: %s', trigger_id['purpose'])
                    raise PreventUpdate

        t1 = time.perf_counter()
        logger.info(f'Input Change for {trigger_id['purpose']} {trigger_id['supersection']} handled in {t1 - t0:.3f}s')

        return rval

    )
    def trigger_feedback_graphs(configuration_update_trigger):

    @app.callback(

    @app.callback(

        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        if triggered_id['supersection'] == 'dsa':

def ids_to_update(
    triggered: list[dict],
    target_ids: list[dict],
    target_type: str,
    target_purpose: str,
) -> tuple[list[dict], set[tuple[str, str]]]:
    """The ids of the result containers or headers to redraw for the triggers of a callback.

    Every trigger is considered, as several may fire together, such as a post-action trigger and the
    refill interval after a run (see `callback_utils.ids_to_update`). The annual/horizon toggle
    redraws every target.

    Args:
        triggered: `ctx.triggered`.
        target_ids: The ids of the containers or headers of the callback.
        target_type: Type of the ids of the targets, e.g. 'result-table'.
        target_purpose: Purpose of the ids of the targets, e.g. 'container'.

    Returns:
        The ids to redraw, and the (section, key) of each table whose options were changed.
    """
    triggers = callback_utils.get_triggers(triggered)
    option_changed = {
        (x.id['section'], x.id['key']) for x in triggers # pyright: ignore[reportIndexIssue, reportCallIssue, reportArgumentType]
        if x.type == 'result-table-option' and 'section' in x.id and 'key' in x.id
    }
    ids = callback_utils.ids_to_update(
        triggers, target_ids, target_type, target_purpose, update_all_types = _UPDATE_ALL_TRIGGER_TYPES
    )
    return ids, option_changed

def result_table_triggers(triggered: list[dict]) -> list[dict] | None:
    """The triggers of the result tables callback to act on: all but the refill interval, unless it ticks to 1.

    The interval is reset to 0 on a change of project and ticks to 1 after, so only the tick redraws. Other
    triggers which fire with the reset (such as post-action triggers) are still acted on.

    Args:
        triggered: `ctx.triggered`.

    Returns:
        The entries of `ctx.triggered` to act on (an empty list on the initial call, which redraws every table), or
        None if there is nothing to act on.
    """
    kept = []
    initial_call = True
    for entry in triggered:
        id_, _ = callback_utils.parse_prop_id(entry.get('prop_id', '.'))
        if id_ is None:
            continue
        initial_call = False
        if id_ == REFILL_INTERVAL_ID and entry.get('value') != 1:
            continue
        kept.append(entry)
    if initial_call:
        return []
    return kept or None

def only_project_changed(triggers: list[callback_utils.Trigger]) -> bool:
    """Whether the active project is the only trigger of the result containers callback.

    Then only the containers drawn for another project are redrawn. A change of page or layout, alone or with the
    project, redraws every container.

    Args:
        triggers: The triggers of the callback.

    Returns:
        Whether only the active project triggered the callback.
    """
    return bool(triggers) and all(x.id == 'active-project-id' for x in triggers)

def add_result_container_callbacks(app: NewsegsDash):
    """
    Callbacks to populate output containers.

    An ouput container is identified by:
    {'type': 'result-container', 'supersection': 'XXX', 'section': 'XXX'}
    """

    @app.callback(
        output = dict(
            containers = Output(
               {
                    'type': 'result-container', 'purpose': 'container',
                    'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                    'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
                }, 'children' 
            ),
            rendered_project_ids = Output(
                {
                    'type': 'result-container', 'purpose': 'container',
                    'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                    'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
                }, 'data-rendered-project-id'
            ),
        ),
        inputs = dict(
            page = Input('url', 'pathname'),
            layout_update_trigger = Input('layout-update-trigger', 'data'),
            active_project_id = Input('active-project-id', 'data'),
        ),
        state = dict(
            app_state = State('app-state', 'data'),
            container_ids = State({
                'type': 'result-container', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'id'),
            rendered_project_ids = State({
                'type': 'result-container', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-project-id'),
        ),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def update_output_container_contents(
        active_project_id,
        app_state,
        container_ids,
        rendered_project_ids,
        **kwargs
    ):
        if active_project_id is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        # Do not update layout if only redrawing the existing project
        is_project_trigger = only_project_changed(callback_utils.get_triggers())

        app_state = json.loads(app_state) if app_state else {}
        model_type = app_state.get('model_type', 'default')

        rval = callback_utils.create_noupdate_return()
        for container_id, rendered_project_id in zip(container_ids, rendered_project_ids):
            project_has_changed = (active_project_id != rendered_project_id)
            if is_project_trigger and not project_has_changed:
                continue

            section = container_id.get('section')
            key_ = container_id.get('key')

            def _not_found():
                logger.exception(
                    'Result container content creator not found for Container ID: %s',
                    container_id
                )

            try:
                content_creator = get_result_container_content_creator(
                    key_, section, model_type
                )
                if content_creator is None:
                    _not_found()
                else:
                    logger.info(
                        'Creating Result Container contents using creator found for %s.%s.%s',
                        key_, section, model_type
                    )
                    callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                        container_id,
                        'children',
                        content_creator(active_project_id, app.project_provider),
                        rval
                    )
                    callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                        container_id,
                        'data-rendered-project-id',
                        active_project_id,
                        rval
                    )

            except KeyError as e:
                _not_found()

        t1 = time.perf_counter()
        logger.info(f'Result Container(s) created in {t1 - t0:.3f}s')
        return rval

    @app.callback(
        output = dict(
            containers = Output(
               {
                    'type': 'result-section-header', 'purpose': 'header',
                    'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                    'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
                }, 'children' 
            )
        ),
        inputs = dict(
            postaction_triggers = Input({
                'type': 'postaction-trigger', 'purpose': 'trigger',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data'),
            ann_hori_toggle = Input(
                {'type': 'annual-horizon-toggle', 'page': ALL}, 
                'value'
            ),
            active_project_id = Input('active-project-id', 'data'),
            trigger_check_stale = Input('trigger-check-stale', 'data'),
        ),
        state = dict(
            app_state = State('app-state', 'data')
        ),
        prevent_initial_call = False, # Want to trigger as we change page
    )
    def update_result_section_header_contents(
        ann_hori_toggle,
        active_project_id,
        app_state,
        **kwargs
    ):
        if active_project_id is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        rval = callback_utils.create_noupdate_return()
        if len(rval) == 0:
            raise PreventUpdate

        headers_for_update, _ = ids_to_update(
            ctx.triggered,
            [x['id'] for x in ctx.outputs_grouping['containers']],
            target_type = 'result-section-header',
            target_purpose = 'header',
        )

        if not headers_for_update:
            return rval

        app_state = json.loads(app_state) if app_state else {}
        model_type = app_state.get('model_type', 'default')

        # Headers of the same section and key (e.g. on different pages) share their contents
        contents_by_section_key = {}
        ann_hori_toggle = ann_hori_toggle[0] if len(ann_hori_toggle) else False

        for container_id in headers_for_update:
            section = container_id['section']
            key = container_id['key']
            if (section, key) in contents_by_section_key:
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id,
                    'children',
                    contents_by_section_key[(section, key)],
                    rval
                )
                continue
            content_creator = get_result_section_header_content_creator(
                key, section, model_type
            )
            if content_creator is None:
                continue
            logger.info(
                'Creating Result Section Header contents using creator found for %s.%s.%s',
                key, section, model_type
            )
            contents = content_creator(
                active_project_id, app.project_provider, app.results_provider, ann_hori_toggle
            )
            contents_by_section_key[(section, key)] = contents
            callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                container_id,
                'children',
                contents,
                rval
            )

        t1 = time.perf_counter()
        logger.info(f'Result Section Header(s) created in {t1 - t0:.3f}s')

        return rval

    @app.callback(
        output = dict(
            table = Output({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'children'),
            data_is_stale = Output({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-is-stale'),
            data_rendered_project_id = Output({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-project-id'),
            data_rendered_project_table_revision = Output({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-project-table-revision'),
            data_rendered_ann_hori_state = Output({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-ann-hori-state'),
            data_rendered_metamodel_id = Output({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-metamodel-id'),
        ),
        inputs = dict(
            postaction_triggers = Input({
                'type': 'postaction-trigger', 'purpose': 'trigger',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data'),
            table_options = dict(
                values = Input({
                    'type': 'result-table-option', 'purpose': ALL,
                    'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                    'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
                }, 'value'),
                ids = State({
                    'type': 'result-table-option', 'purpose': ALL,
                    'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                    'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
                }, 'id'),
            ),
            ann_hori_toggle = Input(
                {'type': 'annual-horizon-toggle', 'page': ALL}, 
                'value'
            ),
            active_project_id_interval = Input('delayed-result-container-refill-interval', 'n_intervals'),
        ),
        state = dict(
            active_project_id = State('active-project-id', 'data'),
            app_state = State('app-state', 'data'),
            container_ids = State({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'id'),
            rendered_project_ids = State({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-project-id'),
            rendered_project_table_revisions =  State({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-project-table-revision'),
            rendered_ann_hori_states =  State({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-ann-hori-state'),
            rendered_metamodel_ids =  State({
                'type': 'result-table', 'purpose': 'container',
                'supersection': ALL, 'section': ALL,
                'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
            }, 'data-rendered-metamodel-id'),
        ),
        prevent_initial_call = False,
    )
    def update_result_section_contents(
        table_options,
        ann_hori_toggle,
        active_project_id,
        app_state,
        container_ids,
        rendered_project_ids,
        rendered_project_table_revisions,
        rendered_ann_hori_states,
        rendered_metamodel_ids,
        **kwargs
    ):
        if active_project_id is None or container_ids is None or not len(container_ids):
            raise PreventUpdate

        # The interval is reset to 0 on project change and then ticks to 1; only act on the tick
        triggered = result_table_triggers(ctx.triggered)
        if triggered is None:
            raise PreventUpdate

        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        rval = callback_utils.create_noupdate_return()

        # Tables whose options were changed must be redrawn even if the revision is unchanged
        tables_for_update, option_changed_tables = ids_to_update(
            triggered,
            [x['id'] for x in ctx.outputs_grouping['table']],
            target_type = 'result-table',
            target_purpose = 'container',
        )
        if not tables_for_update:
            return rval

        # Tables whose post-action trigger fired: their results have just been saved
        result_saved_tables = {
            (x.id['section'], x.id['key']) for x in callback_utils.get_triggers(triggered) # pyright: ignore[reportIndexIssue, reportCallIssue, reportArgumentType]
            if x.type == 'postaction-trigger'
        }

        app_state = json.loads(app_state) if app_state else {}
        model_type = app_state.get('model_type', 'default')

        contents_by_section_subindex = {}
        """
        Local store for contents to prevent redrawing within single call, keyed
        by (section, key, subindex): containers share a section ('tabledraw'),
        so the key is needed to tell their tables apart
        """

        # Do not update if the toggle status has not changed, the project is the same,
        # and the table drawn is of the project's table revision.
        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Updating Result Table Containers')
        lproj = app.project_provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
        table_rev = lproj.table_config.revision
        # The toggle's value is None until first used; normalise so that the
        # rendered state recorded below can match on the next call
        ann_hori_toggle = bool(ann_hori_toggle[0]) if len(ann_hori_toggle) else False

        rendered_project = {
            (k['section'], k['key']) : v for k, v in zip(container_ids, rendered_project_ids)
        }
        rendered_revision = {
            (k['section'], k['key']) : v for k, v in zip(container_ids, rendered_project_table_revisions)
        }
        rendered_ann_hori_state = {
            (k['section'], k['key']) : v for k, v in zip(container_ids, rendered_ann_hori_states)
        }
        rendered_metamodel = {
            (k['section'], k['key']) : v for k, v in zip(container_ids, rendered_metamodel_ids)
        }

        options_per_table = {}
        for id, val in zip(table_options['ids'], table_options['values']):
            lookup = (id['section'], id['key'])
            options_per_table.setdefault(lookup, {})[id['purpose']] = val

        for container_id in tables_for_update:
            section = container_id['section']
            key = container_id['key']
            lookup = (section, key)

            # Find any custom table providers for this table / model
            table_getter = None
            try:
                table_getter = registers.get_table_getter(key, model_type)
            except KeyError:
                pass

            # A getter may read results saved at a revision other than the project's (a configuration's), or saved
            # again at the same one (a DSA run again with other bounds), so the revision recorded doesn't show
            # that its table is still the one drawn: draw it whenever its results have just been saved (#206)
            getter_result_saved = table_getter is not None and lookup in result_saved_tables
            if not getter_result_saved and lookup not in option_changed_tables and rendered_ann_hori_state.get(lookup) is not None and rendered_ann_hori_state[lookup] == ann_hori_toggle:
                if rendered_project.get(lookup) is not None and rendered_project[lookup] == active_project_id:
                    if rendered_revision.get(lookup) is not None and rendered_revision[lookup] == table_rev:
                        # A getter may read the focussed configuration's results, and a change of focus keeps the
                        # project and its revision (#187); the conventional lookup reads the project's
                        if table_getter is None or rendered_metamodel.get(lookup) == lproj.focussed_metamodel_id:
                            continue

            subindex = int(container_id.get('subindex'))
            ss = (section, key, subindex)
            if ss in contents_by_section_subindex:
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id,
                    'children',
                    contents_by_section_subindex[ss][0],
                    rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-is-stale',
                    contents_by_section_subindex[ss][1],
                    rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-project-id',
                    active_project_id, rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-project-table-revision',
                    contents_by_section_subindex[ss][2], rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-ann-hori-state',
                    ann_hori_toggle, rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-metamodel-id',
                    lproj.focussed_metamodel_id, rval
                )
                continue

            opts = options_per_table.get(lookup, {})

            table_name = key
            # 1) Use any custom table provider found above
            if table_getter is not None:
                logger.debug(
                    'Updating Result Table Container using custom getter: Section: %s; Subindex: %s; Key: %s;',
                    section, subindex, key
                )
                opts['ann_hori_toggle'] = ann_hori_toggle
                opts['subindex'] = subindex
                res, rev = table_getter(
                    active_project_id, opts, app.project_provider, app.results_provider
                )

            else:
                # 2) Fall back to conventional table lookup
                if subindex > 0:
                    # Optionally vary the table name from default if subindex != 0
                    subindex_map = registers.get_table_subindex_map(key, model_type)
                    if subindex_map:
                        table_name = subindex_map[subindex]

                # Try with annual or to horizon subtable suffix
                sub_table_name = table_name + '_hori' if ann_hori_toggle else table_name + '_ann'
                res, rev = app.results_provider.get_result(sub_table_name, lproj.table_config)

                if res is None:
                    # Retry without the subtable suffix
                    res, rev = app.results_provider.get_result(table_name, lproj.table_config)
                    logger.debug(
                        'Updating Result Table Container using standard getter: Section: %s; Subindex: %s; Key: %s;',
                        section, subindex, table_name
                    )
                else:
                    logger.debug(
                        'Updating Result Table Container using standard getter: Section: %s; Subindex: %s; Key: %s;',
                        section, subindex, sub_table_name
                    )

            if res is not None:
                logger.debug(
                    'Table found is for revision %d; Current project table revision is %d. Result Table Container Section: %s; Subindex: %s; Key: %s;',
                    rev, lproj.table_config.revision, section, subindex, key
                )
                stale = rev != lproj.table_config.revision
                # The revision of the table drawn is recorded, not the project's, so that a stale table is drawn again
                # once the table of the current revision is saved (#195)
                contents_by_section_subindex[ss] = res, stale, rev
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id,
                    'children',
                    contents_by_section_subindex[ss][0],
                    rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-is-stale',
                    contents_by_section_subindex[ss][1],
                    rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-project-id',
                    active_project_id, rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-project-table-revision',
                    rev, rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-ann-hori-state',
                    ann_hori_toggle, rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-metamodel-id',
                    lproj.focussed_metamodel_id, rval
                )

            else:
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id,
                    'children',
                    [],
                    rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-project-id',
                    active_project_id, rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-is-stale',
                    True,
                    rval
                )
                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    container_id, 'data-rendered-project-table-revision',
                    -1, rval
                )

        t1 = time.perf_counter()
        logger.info(f'Result Table (s) created in {t1 - t0:.3f}s')

        return rval

    # Graphs can't hold data attributes, so can't use them directly
    # for state monitoring.
    @app.callback(

        }, 'value'),

        State({
            'type': 'result-figure', 'purpose': 'container',
            'supersection': ALL, 'section': MATCH,
            'key': MATCH, 'subindex': ALL
        }, 'id'),
        State({
            'type': 'result-table-option', 'purpose': ALL,
            'supersection': ALL, 'section': MATCH,
            'key': MATCH, 'subindex': ALL
        }, 'id'),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def update_result_figure_contents(
        postaction_triggers,
        result_table_options,
        ann_hori_toggle,
        active_project_id,
        app_state,
        container_ids,
        option_ids,
    ):
        if active_project_id is None or container_ids is None or not len(container_ids):
            raise PreventUpdate
        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Updating Result Figure Containers')
        lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
        table_rev = lproj.table_config.revision
        ann_hori_toggle = ann_hori_toggle[0] if len(ann_hori_toggle) else False

        return_contents: list[Any] = [no_update] * len(container_ids)

        contents_by_section_subindex = {}

        app_state = json.loads(app_state) if app_state else {}
        model_type = app_state.get('model_type', 'default')

        table_options = {}
        for optid, optval in zip(option_ids, result_table_options):
            table_options[optid['purpose']] = optval

        for idx, cid in enumerate(container_ids):
            res = None
            rev = None
            section = cid.get('section')
            subindex = int(cid.get('subindex'))
            ss = (section, subindex)
            if ss in contents_by_section_subindex:
                return_contents[idx] = contents_by_section_subindex[ss]
                continue

            key = cid.get('key')
            if not section or not key:
                continue

            table_name = key
            table_getter = None
            try:
                figure_getter = registers.get_table_getter(table_name, model_type)
            except KeyError:
                continue
            if figure_getter is not None:
                logger.debug(
                    'Updating Result Figure Container using custom getter: Section: %s; Subindex: %s; Key: %s;',
                    section, subindex, key
                )
                table_options['ann_hori_toggle'] = ann_hori_toggle
                table_options['subindex'] = subindex
                res, rev = figure_getter(
                    active_project_id, table_options, app.project_provider, app.results_provider
                )

            if res is not None:
                logger.debug(
                    'Figure found is for revision %d; Current project table revision is %d. Result Figure Container Section: %s; Subindex: %s; Key: %s;',
                    rev, lproj.table_config.revision, section, subindex, key
                )
                contents_by_section_subindex[ss] = res
                return_contents[idx] = res
            else:
                # Figures can't record what they were drawn for: the one shown may be of another configuration (#187)
                return_contents[idx] = EMPTY_FIGURE
        t1 = time.perf_counter()
        logger.info(f'Result Figure for {section}, {subindex}, {key} created in {t1 - t0:.3f}s')

        return return_contents

        """
        Show whether results are up to date with their inputs: per page section
        in the staleness indicators, and per configuration in the section headers.
        """
        groups = ctx.outputs_grouping
        indicator_ids = [x['id'] for x in groups['indicator_class']]
        header_ids = [x['id'] for x in groups['header_class']]
        if not active_project_id or not (indicator_ids or header_ids):
            raise PreventUpdate
        t0 = time.perf_counter()

        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Updating staleness feedback')
        lproj = app.project_provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)

        indicator_class, tooltip_children = [], []
        for indicator_id in indicator_ids:
            class_name, text = staleness.indicator_feedback(lproj, indicator_id['process'])
            indicator_class.append(class_name)
            tooltip_children.append(text)

        header_class = []
        if header_ids:
            states = staleness.get_process_states(lproj.metamodels, 'deterministic')
            for header_id in header_ids:
                header_class.append(
                    staleness.result_header_class_name(
                        states.get(header_id['metamodel']),
                        header_id['metamodel'] == lproj.focussed_metamodel_id,
                    )
                )

        t1 = time.perf_counter()
        logger.info(f'Staleness feedback updated in {t1 - t0:.3f}s')

        return dict(
            indicator_class = indicator_class,
            tooltip_children = tooltip_children,
            header_class = header_class,
        )

def timeseries_triggers(triggers: list[callback_utils.Trigger]) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
    """What the triggers of the timeseries callback ask for: every trigger is considered, as several may fire together.

    Args:
        triggers: The triggers of the callback.

    Returns:
        Whether the results changed (the generation table was redrawn), so the plot is rebuilt, and whether a zoom was
        requested.
    """
    results_changed = any(x.is_pattern() and x.id.get('key') == 'table_generation' for x in triggers) # pyright: ignore[reportAttributeAccessIssue]
    zoom_requested = callback_utils.has_trigger(triggers, ZOOM_REQUEST_ID)
    return results_changed, zoom_requested

def add_result_timeseries_callbacks(app: NewsegsDash):
    """Bind the callbacks which draw the timeseries graphs of results.

    Args:
        app: The Dash app.
    """
    resampler.register_update_graph_callback(
        app=app,
        graph_id="graph-timeseries",
    )

    @app.callback(
        Output('timeseries-graph-container', 'style'),
        Output('btn-show-timeseries', 'outline'),
        Output({
            'type': 'postaction-trigger', 'purpose': 'manualtrigger',
            'supersection': 'global', 'section': 'tabledraw',
            'key': 'timeseriesupdate', 'subindex': 0
        }, 'data'),
        Input('btn-show-timeseries', 'n_clicks'),
        State('timeseries-graph-container', 'style'),
        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def toggle_timeseries_visibility(n_clicks, current_style, active_project_id):
        if n_clicks is None:
            raise PreventUpdate

        if current_style.get('display') == 'none':
            r_containerstyle = {
                'display': 'block',
            }
            r_btnoutline = False
        else:
            r_containerstyle = {
                'display': 'none',
            }
            r_btnoutline = True
        return r_containerstyle, r_btnoutline, time.time_ns()

    @app.callback(
        Output('graph-timeseries', 'figure', allow_duplicate = True),
        Output('timeseries-rendered-model-id', 'data'),
        Output('graph-timeseries', 'relayoutData', allow_duplicate = True),

        Input({
            'type': 'postaction-trigger', 'purpose': 'manualtrigger',
            'supersection': 'global', 'section': 'tabledraw',
            'key': 'timeseriesupdate', 'subindex': 0
        }, 'data'),
        Input({
            'type': 'postaction-trigger', 'purpose': 'trigger',
            'supersection': 'global', 'section': 'tabledraw',
            'key': 'table_generation', 'subindex': 0
        }, 'data'),
        Input('active-project-id', 'data'),
        Input('timeseries-zoom-request', 'data'),

        State('timeseries-graph-container', 'style'),
        State('timeseries-rendered-model-id', 'data'),

        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def show_model_timeseries(
        trigger_manual,
        trigger_tables,
        active_project_id,
        zoom_request,
        container_style,
        rendered_model_id,
    ):
        """
        Draw the focussed configuration's timeseries, rebuilding only when the
        model shown or its results have changed, and apply any requested zoom.
        """
        global _resampler_model_id
        if active_project_id is None:
            raise PreventUpdate

        results_changed, zoom_requested = timeseries_triggers(callback_utils.get_triggers())

        if container_style.get('display') == 'none':
            if results_changed:
                # Rebuild when next shown
                return no_update, None, no_update
            raise PreventUpdate

        zoom_range = zoom_request.get('range') if zoom_requested and zoom_request else None

        provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Showing model timeseries')
        lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
        lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]
        model_id = lmm.model.id

        # The graph keeps its figure while hidden, so only redraw when the model
        # or its results differ from those drawn (and held by the resampler)
        if not results_changed and rendered_model_id == model_id and _resampler_model_id == model_id:
            if zoom_range is None:
                raise PreventUpdate
            return _zoom_patch(zoom_range), no_update, no_update

        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        mdl = provider.metamodel_provider._em_provider.get_component(model_id)
        try:
            _ = mdl.get_grid_result()
        except AttributeError:
            mdl.reattach_results(app.results_provider)

        fig = _build_figure(mdl)
        if fig is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        _resampler_model_id = model_id

        relayout = no_update
        if zoom_range is not None:
            fig.update_xaxes(range = zoom_range, autorange = False)
            # Have the resampler's update callback resample the traces for the range
            relayout = _relayout(zoom_range)

        t1 = time.perf_counter()
        logger.info(f'Timeseries plot created in {t1 - t0:.3f}s')
        return fig, model_id, relayout

    @app.callback(
        Output('timeseries-graph-container', 'style', allow_duplicate = True),
        Output('btn-show-timeseries', 'outline', allow_duplicate = True),
        Output('timeseries-zoom-request', 'data'),
        Input({'type': 'result-grid', 'table': ALL}, 'cellClicked'),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def zoom_to_result_cell(cells_clicked):
        """
        Show the timeseries and request a zoom to the date or date range clicked
        in a result grid, where a zoomable cell's value is {'label', 'start'[, 'end']}.
        """
        zoom = (callback_utils.get_triggered_value() or {}).get('value')
        if not isinstance(zoom, dict) or not zoom.get('start'):
            raise PreventUpdate

        return (
            {'display': 'block'},
            False,
            {'range': _zoom_window(zoom), 'timestamp': time.time_ns()}
        )

    return app

docs.title: colours
docs.text:
The colour scheme of the app: the single source of its colours, in the UI and in plots.

The stylesheet takes these colours as CSS custom properties (--ns-*) and the configuration colour classes, which scripts/build_css.py writes into src/assets/newsegs.css. After changing a colour here, rebuild the stylesheet with python scripts/build_css.py; a unit test fails while it is out of date.

The scheme:

  • The background is a cool off-white.
  • Borders and accents are in the purple of ClwydAlyn housing association. It replaces Bootstrap's primary.
  • Configurations (metamodels) each have a colour of the red-green part of the spectrum, starting with the red of Wrexham University, so that a configuration is recognised by its colour in every input, header and plot. Their lightness differs as well as their hue, so that they stay distinct for colour-blind users: the smallest CIEDE2000 difference between two of them is about 10, with normal vision and simulated protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia.
  • Anything else drawn in a plot (energy flows, bounds, bins) takes the cool colours of SERIES_COLOURS or SEQUENTIAL_COLOURS, never a configuration colour.

Plots use the newsegs Plotly template (PLOT_TEMPLATE), registered on import, which sets the text colour, the grid and the colours of series. set_default_plot_template makes it the default of every figure.

def rgba(colour: str, alpha: float) -> str:

def css_tokens() -> str:
    """The colours as CSS: the custom properties on `:root`, and the configuration colour classes.

    Written into the stylesheet by `scripts/build_css.py`.

    Returns:
        The CSS.
    """
    tokens = {
        'bg': BACKGROUND,
        'surface': SURFACE,
        'text': TEXT,
        'muted': MUTED,
        'brand': BRAND,
        'brand-mid': BRAND_MID,
        'brand-soft': BRAND_SOFT,
        'brand-subtle': BRAND_SUBTLE,
        'status-ok': STATUS_OK,
        'status-warning': STATUS_WARNING,
        'status-error': STATUS_ERROR,
        **{f'config-{i + 1}': c for i, c in enumerate(CONFIG_COLOURS)},
    }
    lines = ['/* The colours of components/colours.py */', ':root {']
    lines += [f'    --ns-{k}: {v};' for k, v in tokens.items()]
    lines += [f'    --ns-brand-rgb: {_rgb(BRAND)};', f'    --ns-brand-mid-rgb: {_rgb(BRAND_MID)};', '}', '']
    # Utilities, as Bootstrap's text colours which they replace
    for i, cls in enumerate(CONFIG_COLOUR_CLASSES):
        lines.append(f'.{cls} {{ color: var(--ns-config-{i + 1}) !important; }}')
    return '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'

def generic_create_deterministic_input_container_contents(
    section: str,
    lproj: LightweightNewsegsProject,
    lmm: LightweightNewsegsMetaModel,
    variableprovider: FromDatabaseVariableProvider,
) -> list[dash.development.base_component.Component]:
    """Create the inputs of a section for the deterministic run of a metamodel.

    One input for each variable of the metamodel whose interface section is `section`, with a summary of how the
    configurations of the project share it. The variables of every configuration are fetched in one call.

    Args:
        section: The section.
        lproj: The lightweight project.
        lmm: The lightweight metamodel.
        variableprovider: Provider of variables.

    Returns:
        List of components.
    """
    contents = []
    var_uids = list(dict.fromkeys(uid for x in lproj.metamodels for uid in x.variables.values()))
    lwvars = {x.id: x for x in variableprovider.get_lightweight_variable(var_uids)}
    for varid, var_uid in lmm.variables.items():
        lvar = lwvars[var_uid]
        if lvar.interface_section == section: # and lvar.configuration_show: # TODO: Add configuration_show into lighweight variable
            #if not isinstance(var, variable.ScalarVariable):
            #    raise TypeError(f'Cannot handle variables of type {type(var)}')
            # Create an input
            paramid = VariableInstanceParameterComponentID.from_lightweight_variable(
                lvar,
                type = 'single-input-config',
                supersection = 'deterministic',
            )
            sharing_summary = create_variable_sharing_summary(
                paramid, create_variable_sharing_summary_contents(lproj, varid, lwvars)
            )
            if len(lproj.metamodels) > 1:
                # Opening the summary builds the group editor, which edits and moves between the groups
                sharing_summary = html.Div([
                    create_lazy_input_details(
                        [sharing_summary, html.Span('Hide groups', className = 'group-editor-close-label')],
                        paramid, className = 'group-editor-details',
                    ),
                    create_group_move_request_store(paramid),
                ])
            contents.append(
                dbc_Row([
                    create_blank_single_input_header_element(paramid),
                    create_numeric_card_variable_parameter_input(
                        lvar.icon_name,
                        f'{lvar.label} ({lvar.unit})',
                        paramid,
                        value = lvar.raw_parameter_0, # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
                        #value = var.get_deterministic_value(), # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType]
                        min = lvar.interface_min,
                        max = lvar.interface_max,
                        step = lvar.interface_step if lvar.interface_step else 1,
                        sharing_summary = sharing_summary,
                    ),
                    create_input_group_config_update_trigger(paramid), # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue]
                    create_variable_summary_refresh_trigger(paramid),
                ]
                ) # type: ignore
            )

    return contents

def generic_create_dsa_input_container_contents(
    lmm: LightweightNewsegsMetaModel,
    variable_provider: FromDatabaseVariableProvider,
    lproj: LightweightNewsegsProject | None = None,
) -> list[dash.development.base_component.Component]:
    """Create the inputs for the deterministic sensitivity analysis of a metamodel.

    One DSA input for each variable of the metamodel. Given the project, each input summarises how the configurations'
    Variables of it differ, and can be opened to edit and move between them; the Variables of every configuration are
    fetched in one call.

    Args:
        lmm: The lightweight metamodel (the focussed configuration).
        variable_provider: Provider of variables.
        lproj: The lightweight project.

    Returns:
        List of components.
    """
    from newsegsmodelapp.components.dsa_group_editor import create_dsa_sharing_summary_contents

    metamodels = lproj.metamodels if lproj is not None else [lmm]
    var_uids = list(dict.fromkeys(uid for x in metamodels for uid in x.variables.values()))
    variables = {x.id: x for x in variable_provider.get_full_lightweight_variable(var_uids)}
    contents = []
    for varid, var_uid in lmm.variables.items():
        summary = create_dsa_sharing_summary_contents(lproj, varid, variables) if lproj is not None else []
        contents.append(create_dsa_input(variables[var_uid], summary, len(metamodels)))

    return contents

def create_config_selector_headerbutton(
    config_index: int = 0,
    metamodel: LightweightNewsegsMetaModel | None = None,
    is_focussed: bool | None = None,
):
    """Create the button which focusses a configuration (metamodel) in the page header.

        metamodel: The lightweight metamodel.

        color='primary',
        id = {'type': 'config-hdrfocus-btn', 'index': config_index},
        outline = do_outline,
        title = metamodel.name if metamodel else '',
    )

    return contents

def create_single_configuration_selector_row(
    config_index: int = 0,
    metamodel: LightweightNewsegsMetaModel | None = None,
    is_focussed: bool | None = None,
    reference_size: int = 20,
):

    """Create the row of the configuration selector for one configuration (metamodel).

    The first configuration cannot be removed.

    Args:
        config_index: Index of the configuration (metamodel) within the project.
        metamodel: The lightweight metamodel.
        is_focussed: Whether the configuration is the focussed metamodel.
        reference_size: Size of the icons.

    Returns:
        The row.
    """
    if config_index < 1:
        primary_container = html.H1
        show_remove = False
    else:
        primary_container = html.H2
        show_remove = True

    contents: list[Any] = [icons.get_icon(
        'config-'+str(config_index+1), 
        icon_class = icons.ICON_COLOUR_CLASSES[config_index % len(icons.ICON_COLOUR_CLASSES)]
    ),]

    config_name = metamodel.name if metamodel is not None else ''

    is_focussed = True if is_focussed is None else is_focussed

    # An unnamed configuration shows the hint, at a size to fit it
    contents.append(
        dcc.Input(
            value = config_name,
            placeholder = CONFIGURATION_NAME_HINT,
            debounce = True,
            type = 'text',
            id = {'type': 'config-name-input', 'index': config_index},
            size = str(reference_size * 1.3 if config_name else len(CONFIGURATION_NAME_HINT)),
            className = 'configuration-selector-row-name-input'
        )
    )

    button_container_children = []

    button_container_children += [
        dbc.Button(
            html.I(
                className = icons.get_icon('config-focus', style_name = 'raw'),
                style={'display': 'inline'}
            ),
            color = 'primary',
            id = {'type': 'config-focus-btn', 'index': config_index},
            outline = not(is_focussed),
            title = 'Focus configuration',
        ),

        dbc.Button(
            html.I(
                className = icons.get_icon('config-duplicate', style_name = 'raw'),
                style={'display': 'inline'}
            ),
            color="primary",
            id = {'type': 'config-dup-btn', 'index': config_index},
            outline = True,
            title = 'Duplicate configuration'
        ),

        dbc.Button(
            html.I(
                className = icons.get_icon('config-download', style_name = 'raw'),
                style = {'display': 'inline'}
            ),
            color='secondary',
            id = {'type': 'config-download-btn', 'index': config_index},
            outline = True,
            title = 'Download configuration as json'
        ),

        dcc.Upload(
            dbc.Button(
                html.I(
                    className = icons.get_icon('config-upload', style_name = 'raw'),
                    style = {'display': 'inline'}
                ),
                color='secondary',
                id = {'type': 'config-upload-btn', 'index': config_index},
                outline = True,
                title = 'Overwrite configuration with uploaded json',
            ),
            id = {'type': 'config-upload', 'index': config_index},
            multiple = False,
            enable_folder_selection = False,
            accept = '.json',
            className = 'upload-button'
        ),

        dbc.Button(
            html.I(
                className = icons.get_icon('results-download', style_name = 'raw'),
                style = {'display': 'inline'}
            ),
            color='secondary',
            id = {'type': 'results-predownload-btn', 'page': 'model_configuration', 'key':  f'config-{config_index+1}'},
            outline = True,
            title = 'Download results as spreadsheet'
        ),
    ]

    if show_remove:
        button_container_children.append(
            dbc.Button(
                html.I(
                    className = icons.get_icon('config-remove', style_name = 'raw'),
                    style={'display': 'inline'}
                ),
                color="primary",
                id={'type': 'config-remove-btn', 'index': config_index},
                outline=True,
            )
        )

    button_container = html.Div(
        button_container_children,
        className = 'configuration-selector-row-button-container'
    )

    contents.append(button_container)

    return (
        dbc.Row([
            dbc.Col([
                primary_container(
                    contents
                )
            ])
        ],
        id={'type':'comparator-conf-row', 'index': config_index},
        class_name = 'configuration-selector-row'
        )
    )
