def add_configuration_selector_callbacks(app: NewsegsDash):
    # Populate
    """Bind the callbacks of the configuration selector: showing, focussing, adding, duplicating, removing, uploading and downloading configurations.

    Args:
        app: The Dash app.
    """
    @app.callback(
        Output({'type': 'metamodel-input-container', 'supersection': ALL, 'section': 'configuration-selector'}, 'children'),
        Output({
            'type': 'metamodel-input-container', 'purpose': 'container',
            'supersection': ALL, 'section': 'configuration-header-selector',
            'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
        }, 'children'),

        Input('active-project-id', 'data'),
        State({'type': 'metamodel-input-container', 'supersection': ALL, 'section': 'configuration-selector'}, 'id'),
        State({
            'type': 'metamodel-input-container', 'purpose': 'container',
            'supersection': ALL, 'section': 'configuration-header-selector',
            'key': ALL, 'subindex': ALL
        }, 'id'),
    )
    def population_configuration_selector(
        active_project_id,
        configuration_container_ids,
        configuration_header_ids,
    ):
        if (
            active_project_id is None 
            or (
                len(configuration_container_ids) == 0
                and len(configuration_header_ids) == 0
            )
        ):
            raise PreventUpdate

        provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Populating configuration selector')
        lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
        config_rows = _create_configuration_rows_for_metamodels(lproj.metamodels, lproj.focussed_metamodel_index)
        header_elements = _create_configuration_header_elements_for_metamodels(lproj.metamodels, lproj.focussed_metamodel_index)

        logger.debug(
            "Created configuration selector elements for project %s. "
            "Number of metamodels: %d; Focussed metamodel index: %d;",
            lproj.id, len(lproj.metamodels), lproj.focussed_metamodel_index
        )

        return (
            [config_rows] * len(configuration_container_ids),
            [header_elements] * len(configuration_header_ids)
        )

    # Rename
    @app.callback(
        Output('active-project-id', 'data', allow_duplicate = True),

        Input({'type': 'config-name-input', 'index': ALL}, 'value'),

        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def rename_config(config_names, active_project_id):
        trig = ctx.triggered_id
        if trig is None or len(ctx.triggered) > 1:
            raise PreventUpdate

        provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Renaming metamodel')
        lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)

        mm_index = trig['index']
        new_name = callback_utils.get_triggered_value()

        mm = lproj.metamodels[mm_index]
        if not mm or mm.name == new_name:
            raise PreventUpdate
        if not (new_name or '').strip():
            # A configuration keeps its name: redraw the selector to show it again
            return active_project_id

        old_name = mm.name

        # By changing the metadata, the MM should pick up the new name next time it is
        # taken from the store as the revision will by incremented by default
        # Give the project ID to invalidate cache
        provider.metamodel_provider.set_component_metadata(mm.id, 'label', new_name, project_id = active_project_id)

        logger.info(
            'Renamed metamodel %s; Old name: %s; New name: %s;',
            mm.id, old_name, new_name
        )

        # However, for this to be picked up by the front end, we will have to invalidate the project provider cache
        provider.invalidate_cache_for_component(lproj.id)

        # Trigger a rebuild of the page in case the name is baked into e.g. button titles.
        return active_project_id

    # Duplicate
    @app.callback(
        Output('active-project-id', 'data', allow_duplicate = True),
        Output(CONFIGURATION_NAME_FOCUS_ID, 'data', allow_duplicate = True),

        Input({'type': 'config-dup-btn', 'index': ALL}, 'n_clicks'),

        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def add_duplicate_config(
        n_clicks,
        active_project_id
    ):
        trig = ctx.triggered_id
        if trig is None or len(ctx.triggered) > 1 or not callback_utils.get_triggered_value():
            raise PreventUpdate

        mm_index = trig['index']

        proj = app.project_provider.get_project(active_project_id)
        ref_mm = proj.metamodels[mm_index]

        new_mm = cast(
            NewsegsMetaModel,
            app.project_provider.metamodel_provider.duplicate_component(ref_mm.id) # pyright: ignore[reportAttributeAccessIssue]
        )
        new_mm.name = naming.copy_name(ref_mm.name, (x.name for x in proj.metamodels))

        # Ensure that the variables can be obtained from the project,
        # though they will be identical to the sourced metamodel
        # and so won't add any new variables to the project when the metamodel
        # is appended.
        new_mm.reattach_variables(proj)
        proj.metamodels.append(new_mm) # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType, reportAttributeAccessIssue]

        proj.set_focussed_metamodel(new_mm.id)

        logger.info(
            'Duplicated metamodel %s -> %s; Name: %s; Project revision = %d',
            ref_mm.id, new_mm.id, new_mm.name, proj.revision
        )

        app.project_provider.upsert_component(proj)
        # As a change of name does not dirty the metamodel, need to update that
        app.project_provider.metamodel_provider.set_component_metadata(
            new_mm.id, 'label', new_mm.name
        )

        # Trigger interface update, and put the cursor in the copy's name box, so that the user names it
        return active_project_id, len(proj.metamodels) - 1

    # Focus the name box of a copy, with its name selected, as soon as the selector shows it. Waits for the box
    # itself, not for the selector's callback, which Dash may run seconds after the box appears. Redraws soon after
    # can replace the box, so it is focussed again for a few seconds, unless the user has moved on.
    app.clientside_callback(
        """
        function(index) {
            if (index === null || index === undefined) {
                return window.dash_clientside.no_update;
            }
            const id = JSON.stringify({index: index, type: 'config-name-input'});
            const started = Date.now();
            let focussed = null;
            let focussedAt = null;
            const observer = new MutationObserver(() => attempt());
            const stop = () => observer.disconnect();
            function attempt() {
                const input = document.getElementById(id);
                const now = Date.now();
                if (focussed === null && now - started > 20000) {
                    return stop();
                }
                if (focussedAt !== null && now - focussedAt > 3000) {
                    return stop();
                }
                if (!input || input === document.activeElement) {
                    return;
                }
                const active = document.activeElement;
                if (focussed !== null && active && active !== document.body) {
                    return stop(); // The user is elsewhere
                }
                input.focus();
                input.select();
                focussed = input;
                if (focussedAt === null) {
                    focussedAt = now;
                }
            }
            observer.observe(document.body, {childList: true, subtree: true});
            attempt();
            setTimeout(stop, 25000);
            return window.dash_clientside.no_update;
        }
        """,
        Output(CONFIGURATION_NAME_FOCUS_ID, 'data', allow_duplicate = True),
        Input(CONFIGURATION_NAME_FOCUS_ID, 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call = True,
    )

    # Remove
    @app.callback(
        Output('active-project-id', 'data', allow_duplicate = True),

        Input({'type': 'config-remove-btn', 'index': ALL}, 'n_clicks'),

        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def remove_config(
        n_clicks,
        active_project_id
    ):
        trig = ctx.triggered_id
        if trig is None or len(ctx.triggered) > 1 or not callback_utils.get_triggered_value():
            raise PreventUpdate

        mm_index = trig['index']


        proj = app.project_provider.get_project(active_project_id)
        if len(proj.metamodels) < 2:
            # Do not delete last metamodel.
            raise PreventUpdate

        mm_to_delete = proj.metamodels.pop(mm_index) # pyright: ignore[reportAttributeAccessIssue]
        app.project_provider.metamodel_provider.delete_component(mm_to_delete.id)
        proj.set_focussed_metamodel_index(proj.get_focussed_metamodel_index())

        logger.info(
            'Deleted metamodel %s from project %s; Project has %d metamodels and the focussed metamodel is %d.',
            mm_to_delete.id, proj.id, len(proj.metamodels), proj.get_focussed_metamodel_index()
        )

        # Should be no need to increment the revision - should occur automatically on pop of the metamodel
        # proj.revision += 1
        app.project_provider.upsert_component(proj)

        # Trigger interface update
        return active_project_id

    # Focus
    @app.callback(
        Output('active-project-id', 'data', allow_duplicate = True),

        Input({'type': 'config-focus-btn', 'index': ALL}, 'n_clicks'),
        Input({'type': 'config-hdrfocus-btn', 'index': ALL}, 'n_clicks'),

        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def set_focussed_config(
        n_clicks,
        n_clicks_hdr,
        active_project_id
    ):
        # The buttons fire together, with no clicks, when they are drawn: act on the one clicked
        clicked = callback_utils.get_clicked_trigger()
        if clicked is None or not active_project_id:
            raise PreventUpdate

        mm_index = clicked.id['index'] # pyright: ignore[reportIndexIssue, reportCallIssue, reportArgumentType]
        provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Setting focussed metamodel')
        lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)

        if lproj.focussed_metamodel_index == mm_index:
            raise PreventUpdate

        old_mm_index = lproj.focussed_metamodel_index
        mm_id = lproj.metamodels[mm_index].id

        provider.set_component_metadata(
            lproj.id, 'focussed_metamodel_id',
            mm_id, increment_revision = False,
        )

        logger.info(
            "Changed focussed metamodel index from %d to %d for project %s.",
            old_mm_index, mm_index, lproj.id
        )

        # Trigger interface update
        # Could be a bit more elegant, but may have to rebuild inputs for some configurations anyway so brute force for now.
        return active_project_id

    # Download metamodel
    @app.callback(
        Output('download-config-json', 'data'),

        Input({'type': 'config-download-btn', 'index': ALL}, 'n_clicks'),

        State('active-project-id', 'data'),

        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def download_config_json(n_clicks, active_project_id):
        trig = ctx.triggered_id
        if trig is None or len(ctx.triggered) > 1 or not callback_utils.get_triggered_value():
            raise PreventUpdate

        mm_index = trig['index']
        proj = app.project_provider.get_project(active_project_id)

        mm = proj.metamodels[mm_index]

        odict = metamodel_to_config_file(mm)

        fn = (odict.get('config_name') or 'configuration') + ".json"
        fn = pathvalidate.sanitize_filename(fn)

        logger.info(
            'Downloading metamodel %s to file %s',
            mm.id, fn
        )

        return dict(
            content = json.dumps(odict, cls = jsonfuncs.NumpyEncoder, sort_keys=False, indent=4), 
            filename = fn
        )

    # Upload metamodel
    @app.callback(
        Output('active-project-id', 'data', allow_duplicate = True),

        Input({'type': 'config-upload', 'index': ALL}, 'contents'),

        State('active-project-id', 'data'),

        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def upload_config_json(config_jsons, active_project_id):
        trig = ctx.triggered_id
        if trig is None or len(ctx.triggered) > 1:
            raise PreventUpdate

        trig_val = callback_utils.get_triggered_value()
        if not trig_val:
            raise PreventUpdate

        try:
            working_conf = trig_val
            ctype, cstr = working_conf.split(',')
            cfg = json.loads(base64.b64decode(cstr))
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            logging.exception('Could not decode uploaded metamodel configuration', exc_info = True)
            raise PreventUpdate

        mm_config = cfg.get('metamodel')
        if mm_config is None:
            mm_config = cfg
        constr = find_constructor(mm_config['constructor_class'], mm_config['class'])
        if not constr:
            raise PreventUpdate

        mm_new = cast(NewsegsMetaModel, constr(mm_config))
        # Caution: We cannot safely add this new metamodel to the project until we have generated new ids
        # for each component. The variables are given new ids too: with the ids in the file, they would be the
        # variables the file was exported from, so the upload would overwrite their values, and editing it would
        # change the configurations that share them, in this or another project.
        mm_new.anonymise_ids(include_variables = True)

        proj = app.project_provider.get_project(active_project_id)
        mm_new.name = naming.unique_name(mm_new.name, (x.name for x in proj.metamodels))
        proj.metamodels.append(mm_new) # pyright: ignore[reportAttributeAccessIssue]
        proj.set_focussed_metamodel(mm_new.id)
        # Project revision increment should occur on the metamodels.append
        # proj.revision += 1
        app.project_provider.upsert_component(proj)

        logger.info(
            'Added uploaded metamodel to project. Project ID: %s; Metamodel ID: %s; Metamodel name: %s;',
            proj.id, mm_new.id, mm_new.name,
        )

        return active_project_id

    # Download results
    @app.callback(
        output = {
            'modal': {
                'is_opens': Output(
                    {'type': 'modal-confirm', 'page': ALL, 'key':'det-download-confirm'},

            },

        },
        inputs = {
            'results_download_button': {
                'n_clicks': Input({'type': 'results-download-btn', 'page': ALL, 'key': 'det'}, 'n_clicks'),
            },
            'modal_close_button': {

                )

            },
            'results_predownload_button': {
                'n_clicks': Input({'type': 'results-predownload-btn', 'page': 'model_configuration', 'key': ALL}, 'n_clicks'),
            },
        },
        state = {
            'modal': {
                'ids': State(

                    'id'
                )
            },
            'options': {
                'values': State(

                ),
                'ids': State(

                )
            },
            'download': {
                'ids': State(
                    {'type': 'results-download-component', 'page': ALL, 'key': 'det'},
                    'id'
                )
            },
            'toast': {
                'ids':  State(
                    {'type': 'result-download-feedback-toast', 'page': ALL, 'key': 'det'},
                    'id'
                ),
            },
            'information': {
                'values': State(
                    {'type': 'result-download-information', 'page': ALL, 'key': 'det'},
                    'data'
                ),
                'ids': State(
                    {'type': 'result-download-information', 'page': ALL, 'key': 'det'},
                    'id'
                ),
            },
            'active_project_id': State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        },
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def confirm_det_results_download(
        results_download_button,
        modal_close_button,
        results_predownload_button,
        modal,
        options,
        download,
        toast,
        information,
        active_project_id,
    ):

        n_modals = len(modal['ids'])
        n_downloads = len(download['ids'])
        n_toast = len(toast['ids'])
        n_information = len(information['ids'])
        rval: dict[str, Any] = dict(
            modal = dict(is_opens = [no_update] * n_modals),
            download = dict(datas = [no_update] * n_downloads),
            toast = dict(
                children = [no_update] * n_toast,
                is_opens = [no_update] * n_toast
            ),
            information = dict(
                values = [no_update] * n_information
            )
        )

        clicked = callback_utils.get_clicked_trigger()
        if clicked is None or not clicked.is_pattern():
            return rval
        trig_id = cast(dict, clicked.id)

        match trig_id.get('type'):
            case 'results-predownload-btn':
                config_index_str = trig_id.get('key')
                rval['modal']['is_opens'] = [True] * n_modals
                rval['information']['values'] = [config_index_str] * n_information
                return rval
            case 'results-download-btn':
                rval['modal']['is_opens'] = [False] * n_modals
                if n_information == 0:
                    rval['toast']['children'] = ['Unable to determine configuration'] * n_toast
                    rval['toast']['is_opens'] = [True] * n_toast
                    return rval
                config_index_str = information['values'][0]
                if config_index_str is None:
                    rval['toast']['children'] = ['Unable to determine configuration'] * n_toast
                    rval['toast']['is_opens'] = [True] * n_toast
                    return rval
                config_index = int(str(config_index_str).lstrip('config-'))-1

                proj = app.project_provider.get_project(active_project_id)
                configurations = proj.metamodels

                if config_index >= len(configurations):
                    rval['toast']['children'] = ['Configuration index out of range'] * n_toast
                    rval['toast']['is_opens'] = [True] * n_toast
                    return rval

                mm = configurations[config_index]

                if mm is None:
                    rval['toast']['children'] = ['Could not retrieve the configuration'] * n_toast
                    rval['toast']['is_opens'] = [True] * n_toast
                    return rval

                mm.model.reattach_results(app.results_provider)

                #if mm.model.dirty or mm.finance.dirty:
                #    rval['toast']['children'] = ['Deterministic results not run for current configuration'] * n_toast
                #    rval['toast']['is_opens'] = [True] * n_toast
                #    return rval

                page = trig_id.get('page')

                opts = callback_utils.get_options(
                    options['ids'],
                    options['values'],
                    page,
                    ['contents-option', 'format-option']
                )

                to_export = export.export_results(
                    'det',
                    app.project_provider,
                    app.results_provider,
                    active_project_id,
                    contents_option = opts.get('contents-option', 'result'),
                    format_option = opts.get('format-option', 'csv'),
                    result_level = 'metamodel'
                )

                if to_export is None:
                    rval['toast']['children'] = ['Deterministic results not available for current configuration'] * n_toast
                    rval['toast']['is_opens'] = [True] * n_toast
                    return rval

                for idx, id in enumerate(download['ids']):
                    if id['page'] == page:
                        rval['download']['datas'][idx] = to_export
            case _:
                rval['modal']['is_opens'] = [False] * n_modals
        return rval

def set_dsa_bound(provider: FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, lproj: LightweightNewsegsProject, var, purpose: str, value: Any) -> bool:
    """Set a DSA bound of a Variable of a project, and save it if it changed.

    Args:
        provider: Provider of the project.
        lproj: The lightweight project.
        var: The Variable; not necessarily the focussed configuration's.
        purpose: `bound-lower` or `bound-upper`.
        value: The bound, in the terms of the Variable's bound type.

    Returns:
        Whether the bound changed.
    """
    attribute = 'dsa_lower' if purpose.endswith('bound-lower') else 'dsa_upper'
    if np.array_equal(np.asarray(value, dtype = object), np.asarray(getattr(var, attribute), dtype = object)):
        return False
    setattr(var, attribute, value)
    _save_dsa_change(provider, lproj, var)
    return True

def set_dsa_bound_type(provider: FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, lproj: LightweightNewsegsProject, var, bound_type: str) -> bool:
    """Set the DSA bound type of a Variable of a project, with the bounds its distribution suggests for the type.

    Args:
        provider: Provider of the project.
        lproj: The lightweight project.
        var: The Variable; not necessarily the focussed configuration's.
        bound_type: The bound type.

    Returns:
        Whether the type changed.
    """
    if not bound_type or bound_type == var.dsa_bounds_type:
        return False
    var.dsa_bounds_type = bound_type
    var.dsa_lower, var.dsa_upper = var.distribution.dsa_auto_values(var)
    _save_dsa_change(provider, lproj, var)
    return True

def dsa_bounds_differ(variables: Sequence[FullLightweightVariable]) -> bool:
    """Whether Variables have different DSA bound types or bound settings.

    Bounds calculated from the same settings on different values don't differ: the same relative bound gives different
    values on different values.

    Args:
        variables: The Variables, e.g. of the groups of a variable.

    Returns:
        Whether they differ.
    """
    return len({_settings(x) for x in variables}) > 1

def count_variables_with_different_bounds(lproj: LightweightNewsegsProject, variables: Mapping[str, FullLightweightVariable]) -> int:
    """The number of the variables shown on the DSA page whose groups have different DSA bound types or settings.

    Args:
        lproj: The lightweight project.
        variables: The Variables of the project, by id.

    Returns:
        The number of variables.
    """
    varids = dict.fromkeys(varid for lmm in lproj.metamodels for varid in lmm.variables)
    n = 0
    for varid in varids:
        group_vars = [variables[x.var_uid] for x in get_variable_groups(lproj, varid) if x.var_uid in variables]
        if group_vars and group_vars[0].dsa_show and dsa_bounds_differ(group_vars):
            n += 1
    return n

def create_dsa_sharing_summary_contents(
    proj: LightweightNewsegsProject,
    varid: str,
    variables: Mapping[str, FullLightweightVariable],
) -> list:
    """Create what the DSA row's summary line shows: nothing unless there are several groups; otherwise each group's
    configurations, value and calculated bounds, and `≠ bounds` if their bound types or settings differ.

    Args:
        proj: The lightweight project.
        varid: Id of the variable.
        variables: The Variables of the project, by id; it needs only those of the groups.

    Returns:
        The children of the summary.
    """
    groups = [x for x in get_variable_groups(proj, varid) if x.var_uid is not None]
    if len(proj.metamodels) <= 1 or len(groups) <= 1:
        return []
    focussed_index = proj.focussed_metamodel_index
    line = []
    for group in groups:
        if line:
            line.append(' · ')
        var = variables[cast(str, group.var_uid)]
        class_name = 'variable-sharing-group' + (' focussed' if focussed_index in group.metamodel_indices else '')
        line.append(html.Span([*_config_icons(group.metamodel_indices), ' ', _value_and_bounds(var)], className = class_name))
    if dsa_bounds_differ([variables[cast(str, x.var_uid)] for x in groups]):
        line.append(html.Span('≠ bounds', className = 'dsa-bounds-differ', title = 'The groups have different bound types or settings'))
    return line

def create_dsa_group_editor_contents(varid: str, active_project_id: str, project_provider: NewsegsProjectProviderInterface) -> list:
    """Create the DSA row's editor: a row for each group, with its value, bound type and bounds, and its configurations.

    The focussed configuration's row holds its usual inputs. A project with one configuration has that row alone.

    Args:
        varid: Id of the variable.
        active_project_id: Id of the project.
        project_provider: Provider of the project.

    Returns:
        The children of the row's `input-group-editor` container.
    """
    provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, project_provider)
    lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
    groups = [x for x in get_variable_groups(lproj, varid) if x.var_uid is not None]
    if not groups:
        return []
    variables = {x.id: x for x in provider.variable_provider.get_full_lightweight_variable([cast(str, x.var_uid) for x in groups])}
    focussed_index = lproj.focussed_metamodel_index

    if len(lproj.metamodels) <= 1:
        var = variables[cast(str, groups[0].var_uid)]
        return [html.Div(html.Div(_focussed_cells(var), className = 'group-editor-row dsa-group-row'), className = 'group-editor group-editor-dsa')]

    rows = []
    for group in groups:
        var = variables[cast(str, group.var_uid)]
        is_focussed = focussed_index in group.metamodel_indices
        cells = _focussed_cells(var) if is_focussed else _group_cells(varid, var)
        rows.append(create_group_row(cells, group, focussed_index, _value_and_bounds(var), len(groups), className = 'dsa-group-row'))
    head = [html.Span('Value'), html.Span('Bounds'), html.Span('Lower, upper'), html.Span('Group')]
    return create_group_editor_frame(varid, SUPERSECTION, head, rows)

class EstimatedEnergyBalance:
    """A rough estimate of the annual energy balance, and the maximum daily balance, of a site.

    Generation and consumption are estimated from capacities, capacity factors and the number of households with simple formulae, so that the interface
    can give feedback as inputs are changed without running a NewSEGS Energy Model. Each `set_...` method updates one line of the estimate.
    """
    def __init__(self):
        self.estimated_annual_energy_balance = pd.DataFrame([
            {'type': 'Generation', 'label': 'Wind', 'value': 1.},
            {'type': 'Generation', 'label': 'PV', 'value': 1.},
            {'type': 'Consumption', 'label': 'Space heat', 'value': 1.},
            {'type': 'Consumption', 'label': 'Hot water', 'value': 1.},
            {'type': 'Consumption', 'label': 'Direct consumption', 'value': 1.},
            {'type': 'Consumption', 'label': 'EV charging', 'value': 1.}
        ]).set_index('label', drop = False)

        self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance = pd.DataFrame([
            {'label': 'Wind', 'value': 1.},
            {'label': 'PV', 'value': 1.},
            {'label': 'All generation', 'value': 1.},
            {'label': 'Consumption', 'value': 1.},
            {'label': 'Storage size', 'value': 1.},
        ]).set_index('label', drop = False)

    def _set_max_gen(self):
        max_wind = self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance.at['Wind', 'value']
        max_wind = cast(float, max_wind)

        max_pv = self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance.at['PV', 'value']
        max_pv = cast(float, max_pv)

        PV_CF_ON_MAX_WIND = 0.19
        PV_CF_ON_MAX_DAY = 0.33
        pv_contribution_max_wind = PV_CF_ON_MAX_WIND * max_pv / PV_CF_ON_MAX_DAY

        WIND_CF_ON_MAX_PV = 0.12
        WIND_CF_ON_MAX_DAY = 1.0
        wind_contribution_max_pv = WIND_CF_ON_MAX_PV * max_wind / WIND_CF_ON_MAX_DAY


        if (max_wind + pv_contribution_max_wind) > max_pv:
            # Assume that greatest day is combination of wind and pv
            self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance.at['All generation', 'value'] = max_wind + pv_contribution_max_wind
        else:
            # Assume that greatest day is coincident with PV peak
            self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance.at['All generation', 'value'] = max_pv + wind_contribution_max_pv

    def _set_max_consumption(self):
        MEAN_DAILY_MULTIPLIERS = {
            'Space heat': 4.04,
            'Hot water': 1.12,
            'Direct consumption': 1.13,
            'EV charging': 1.16
        }
        tot = 0.
        for k,v in MEAN_DAILY_MULTIPLIERS.items():
            tot += v * self.estimated_annual_energy_balance.at[k,'value'] / 365 
        self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance.at['Consumption', 'value'] = tot

    def set_wind_generation(
        self, 
        cap,
        ann_cf: float = 0.25,
        max_day_cf: float = 1.0
    ):
        """Estimate the generation from wind.

        Annually, `8760 * ann_cf * cap`; on the maximum day, `24 * cap * max_day_cf`.

        Args:
            cap: Capacity (kW).
            ann_cf: Annual capacity factor.
            max_day_cf: Capacity factor on the day of the maximum.
        """
        self.estimated_annual_energy_balance.at['Wind', 'value'] = 8760 * ann_cf * cap

        self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance.at['Wind', 'value'] = 24 * cap * max_day_cf
        self._set_max_gen()

    def set_pv_generation(
        self, 
        cap, 
        ann_cf: float = 0.125,
        max_day_cf: float = 0.33
    ):
        """Estimate the generation from PV.

        Annually, `8760 * ann_cf * cap`; on the maximum day, `24 * cap * max_day_cf`.

        Args:
            cap: Capacity (kW).
            ann_cf: Annual capacity factor.
            max_day_cf: Capacity factor on the day of the maximum.
        """
        self.estimated_annual_energy_balance.at['PV', 'value'] = 8760 * ann_cf * cap

        self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance.at['PV', 'value'] = 24 * cap * max_day_cf
        self._set_max_gen()

    def set_spaceheat_consumption(
        self,
        n_units,
        hlp,
        gfa,
        ann_hdd: float = 2000.0
    ):
        """Estimate the consumption for space heating.

        Households times heat loss parameter times floor area times annual heating degree days, converted to kWh.

        Args:
            n_units: Number of households.
            hlp: Heat loss parameter.
            gfa: Gross floor area of a dwelling (m^2).
            ann_hdd: Annual heating degree days.
        """
        self.estimated_annual_energy_balance.at['Space heat', 'value'] = n_units * hlp * gfa * ann_hdd * 24 / 1000.

        self._set_max_consumption()

    def set_dhw_consumption(
        self, 
        n_units, 
        ref_daily_consumption, 
        conversion_efficiency: float = 1.0
    ):
        """Estimate the consumption for domestic hot water.

        Households times the reference daily consumption times 365, divided by the conversion efficiency.

        Args:
            n_units: Number of households.
            ref_daily_consumption: Reference daily hot water consumption of a household (kWh).
            conversion_efficiency: Efficiency of conversion to hot water.
        """
        self.estimated_annual_energy_balance.at['Hot water', 'value'] = 365. * n_units * ref_daily_consumption / conversion_efficiency
        self._set_max_consumption()

    def set_direct_consumption(self, n_units, ann_demand_per_unit):
        """Estimate the direct (appliance) consumption.

        Households times the annual demand per household.

        Args:
            n_units: Number of households.
            ann_demand_per_unit: Annual demand per household (kWh).
        """
        self.estimated_annual_energy_balance.at['Direct consumption', 'value'] = n_units * ann_demand_per_unit
        self._set_max_consumption()

    def set_ev_consumption(
        self,
        n_units, 
        annual_residential_consumption_per_ev, 
        n_evs_per_household
    ):
        """Estimate the consumption for EV charging.

        Households times the annual residential consumption per EV times the number of EVs per household.

        Args:
            n_units: Number of households.
            annual_residential_consumption_per_ev: Annual residential charging consumption of an EV (kWh).
            n_evs_per_household: Number of EVs per household.
        """
        self.estimated_annual_energy_balance.at['EV charging', 'value'] = n_units * annual_residential_consumption_per_ev * n_evs_per_household
        self._set_max_consumption()

    def set_storage_capacity(
        self,
        storage_capacity
    ):
        """Set the storage capacity of the estimate.

        Args:
            storage_capacity: Storage capacity (kWh).
        """
        self.estimated_maximum_daily_balance.at['Storage size', 'value'] = storage_capacity

    """

def export_results(
    result_type: Literal['dsa','psa','det'],
    project_provider: NewsegsProjectProviderInterface,
    result_provider: NewsegsResultProviderInterface,
    project_id: str,
    metamodel_id: Optional[str] = None,
    contents_option: str = 'result',
    format_option: str = 'csv',
    result_level: Optional[str] = None,
):
    """Export the results of a deterministic run, or a DSA or PSA, of a project.

    Raises `NotImplementedError` for combinations that are not yet supported, such as DSA at project level.

    Args:
        result_type: The type of analysis: `det`, `dsa` or `psa`.
        project_provider: Provider of projects, metamodels and variables.
        result_provider: Provider of results.
        project_id: Id of the project.
        metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.
        contents_option: What to export.
        format_option: The format of the file.
        result_level: The level of the results (project or metamodel).

    Returns:
        The data to download.
    """
    proj = project_provider.get_project(project_id)
    match result_type:
        case 'dsa':
            result_level = 'project' if result_level is None else result_level
            match result_level:
                case 'project':
                    raise NotImplementedError(f'DSA at project level not yet supported')
                case 'metamodel':
                    if metamodel_id is None:
                        metamodel_id = project_provider.get_focussed_metamodel_id(project_id)
                    mm = proj.get_metamodel_by_id(metamodel_id)
                    result_data, result_revision = result_provider.get_result(
                        'dsa_single_metamodel', mm.table_config, True
                    )
                    if result_data is None:
                        return None
                    stale = result_revision != mm.table_config.revision
                    assert isinstance(result_data, pd.DataFrame)
                case _:
                    raise ValueError(f'result_level not recognised: {result_level}')
        case 'psa':
            result_level = 'project' if result_level is None else result_level
            match result_level:
                case 'project':
                    raise NotImplementedError(f'PSA at project level not yet supported')
                case 'metamodel':
                    if metamodel_id is None:
                        metamodel_id = project_provider.get_focussed_metamodel_id(project_id)
                    mm = proj.get_metamodel_by_id(metamodel_id)
                    result_data, result_revision = result_provider.get_result(
                        'psa_single_metamodel', mm.table_config, True
                    )
                    if result_data is None:
                        return None
                    stale = result_revision != mm.table_config.revision
                    assert isinstance(result_data, pd.DataFrame)
                case _:
                    raise ValueError(f'result_level not recognised: {result_level}')
        case 'det':
            result_level = 'metamodel' if result_level is None else result_level
            match result_level:
                case 'project':
                    raise NotImplementedError('Deterministic results export for full project not yet supported')
                case 'metamodel':
                    if metamodel_id is None:
                        metamodel_id = project_provider.get_focussed_metamodel_id(project_id)
                    mm = proj.get_metamodel_by_id(metamodel_id)
                    stale = mm.model.reattach_results(result_provider)

                    result_data = _get_metamodel_deterministic_raw_data(mm)
                    if result_data is None:
                        return None
                    assert isinstance(result_data, pd.DataFrame)
                case _:
                    raise ValueError(f'result_level not recognised: {result_level}')
        case _:
            raise ValueError(f'result_type not recognised: {result_type}')

    def _strip_index_tz(df):
        index = df.index
        if getattr(index, 'tz', None) is not None:
            df = df.copy()
            df.index = index.tz_localize(None)
        return df

    def _make_project_filename_stub():
        proj_metadata = project_provider.get_component_metadata(project_id, 'label')
        proj_name = proj_metadata.get('label')
        return f'{proj_name}-{result_type}-results'

    def _make_metamodel_filename_stub(metamodel_id):
        mm_metadata = project_provider.metamodel_provider.get_component_metadata(metamodel_id, 'label')
        mm_name = mm_metadata.get('label')
        return f'{mm_name}-{result_type}-results'

    match result_level:
        case 'project':
            file_name_stub = _make_project_filename_stub()
        case 'metamodel':
            file_name_stub = _make_metamodel_filename_stub(metamodel_id)

    match contents_option:
        case 'result':
            out_fn = pathvalidate.sanitize_filename(f'{file_name_stub}.{format_option}')
        case 'result_and_config':
            out_fn = pathvalidate.sanitize_filename(f'{file_name_stub}.zip')
        case _:
            raise ValueError(f'contents_option not recognised: {contents_option}')

    match contents_option:
        case 'result':
            match format_option:
                case 'csv':
                    return dcc.send_data_frame(result_data.to_csv, out_fn)
                case 'xlsx':
                    result_data_for_export = _strip_index_tz(result_data)
                    return dcc.send_data_frame(
                        result_data_for_export.to_excel,
                        out_fn,
                        sheet_name = f'{result_type} results'
                    )
                case _:
                    raise ValueError(f'format_option not recognised: {format_option}')
        case 'result_and_config':
            result_fn = pathvalidate.sanitize_filename(f'{file_name_stub}.{format_option}')
            match format_option:
                case 'csv':
                    results_mode = 'w+b'
                case 'xlsx':
                    results_mode = 'w+b'
                case _:
                    raise ValueError(f'format_option not recognised: {format_option}')

            match result_level:
                case 'project':
                    config_dict = proj.to_dict_repr()
                    config_file_name = f'{proj.name}-config.json'
                case 'metamodel':
                    config_dict = mm.to_dict_repr()
                    config_file_name = f'{mm.name}-config.json'
                case _:
                    raise ValueError(f'result_level not recognised: {result_level}')

            with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode = results_mode, suffix = result_fn) as resultsfile:
                match format_option:
                    case 'csv':
                        result_data.to_csv(resultsfile)
                    case 'xlsx':
                        result_data_for_export = _strip_index_tz(result_data)
                        result_data_for_export.to_excel(resultsfile, sheet_name = f'{result_type} results')
                resultsfile.seek(0)

                with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode = 'w+', suffix = '.json') as configfile:
                    json.dump(
                        config_dict,
                        configfile,
                        cls = jsonfuncs.NumpyEncoder,
                        sort_keys = False, indent = 4
                    )
                    configfile.seek(0)

                    with io.BytesIO() as zip_buffer:
                        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_buffer, mode = 'w', compression = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as ziparchive:
                            ziparchive.writestr(result_fn, resultsfile.read())
                            ziparchive.writestr(
                                pathvalidate.sanitize_filename(
                                    config_file_name
                                ),
                                configfile.read()
                            )
                        zip_buffer.seek(0)
                        return dcc.send_bytes(
                            lambda buffer: buffer.write(zip_buffer.getvalue()),
                            filename = out_fn
                        )

docs.title: group_editor
docs.text:
The group editor of an input on the site configuration page: every group's value, and moving configurations between groups.

A group is one instance of a variable (a Variable) and the configurations using it. The editor is built when its row is opened (see input_components.create_lazy_input_details). It holds a row for each group, with the group's value (the focussed group's is edited in the main input) and its configuration icons, and a row for a new value.

Selecting an icon and choosing a row to move it to happens in the browser (assets/group_editor.js), which writes the move to the row's group-move-request store. react_to_input_change passes the move, and changes of the values of the other groups (group-value-input), to the handlers here. Both redraw only the row's editor and summary, and the main input, header and triggers of the row when the focussed configuration's Variable changes.

docs.title: move_metamodels_to_group(provider, lproj, varid, mm_indices, target)
docs.text:
Move configurations to a group: give them a Variable of the project, or each a copy of its own.

All the moves are applied as one operation: the Variables are reassigned, then those left without a configuration are removed, and the configurations, their tables and the project are revised once. Each moved configuration has the processes that the swap of Variable affects marked stale. The configurations need not include the focussed one.

A configuration already using the target, or already alone in its group when the target is a new value, is left as it is, so no group is left without a configuration.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default provider FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider

Provider of the project.

required lproj LightweightNewsegsProject

The lightweight project. Its configurations' Variables are updated.

required varid str

Id of the variable.

required mm_indices Sequence[int]

Indices of the configurations to move.

required target str

Id of a Variable of the project for the variable, or NEW_VARIABLE.

required

Returns:

Type Description GroupMoves

What changed.

Raises:

Type Description ValueError

If the target is not a Variable of the project for the variable, or a configuration does not exist or has no Variable for the variable. Nothing is changed.

Source code in src/newsegsmodelapp/components/group_editor.py 
def move_metamodels_to_group(
    provider: FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider,
    lproj: LightweightNewsegsProject,
    varid: str,
    mm_indices: Sequence[int],
    target: str,
) -> GroupMoves:
    """Move configurations to a group: give them a Variable of the project, or each a copy of its own.

    All the moves are applied as one operation: the Variables are reassigned, then those left without a configuration
    are removed, and the configurations, their tables and the project are revised once. Each moved configuration has the
    processes that the swap of Variable affects marked stale. The configurations need not include the focussed one.

    A configuration already using the target, or already alone in its group when the target is a new value, is left as
    it is, so no group is left without a configuration.

    Args:
        provider: Provider of the project.
        lproj: The lightweight project. Its configurations' Variables are updated.
        varid: Id of the variable.
        mm_indices: Indices of the configurations to move.
        target: Id of a Variable of the project for the variable, or `NEW_VARIABLE`.

    Returns:
        What changed.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If the target is not a Variable of the project for the variable, or a configuration does not exist
            or has no Variable for the variable. Nothing is changed.
    """
    groups = [x for x in get_variable_groups(lproj, varid) if x.var_uid is not None]
    group_sizes = {x.var_uid: len(x.metamodel_indices) for x in groups}
    if target != NEW_VARIABLE and target not in group_sizes:
        raise ValueError(f'{target} is not a Variable of the project for {varid}')
    for idx in mm_indices:
        if not 0 <= idx < len(lproj.metamodels) or varid not in lproj.metamodels[idx].variables:
            raise ValueError(f'Configuration {idx} has no Variable for {varid}')

    # (configuration index, old Variable, new Variable)
    moves: list[tuple[int, str, str]] = []
    result = GroupMoves()
    for idx in dict.fromkeys(mm_indices):
        old_uid = lproj.metamodels[idx].variables[varid]
        if target == NEW_VARIABLE:
            if group_sizes[old_uid] == 1:
                continue
            var = provider.variable_provider.duplicate_variable(old_uid)
            provider.add_variables_to_project(lproj.id, [var])
            group_sizes[old_uid] -= 1
            result.created.append(var.id)
            moves.append((idx, old_uid, var.id))
        elif old_uid != target:
            moves.append((idx, old_uid, target))
    if not moves:
        return result

    old_vars = {old: provider.variable_provider.get_variable(old) for _, old, _ in moves}
    for idx, _, new_uid in moves:
        lproj.metamodels[idx].variables[varid] = new_uid
    result.moved = [idx for idx, _, _ in moves]

    in_use = {x.variables.get(varid) for x in lproj.metamodels}
    result.removed = [x for x in dict.fromkeys(old for _, old, _ in moves) if x not in in_use]
    if result.removed:
        provider.remove_variables_from_project(lproj.id, result.removed)

    moved_lmms = [lproj.metamodels[idx] for idx in result.moved]
    for lmm in moved_lmms:
        provider.metamodel_provider.refresh_metamodel_variable_junction(
            lmm, [provider.variable_provider.get_lightweight_variable(lmm.variables[varid])]
        )

    provider._component_provider.increment_revision(
        [x.table_config.id for x in moved_lmms] + [lproj.table_config.id]
    )
    provider.metamodel_provider.increment_revision([x.id for x in moved_lmms])
    provider.increment_revision(lproj.id)

    for idx, old_uid, new_uid in moves:
        db_staleness.mark_inputs_changed(
            lproj.metamodels[idx].id,
            staleness.processes_affected_by_variable_swap(
                old_vars[old_uid], provider.variable_provider.get_variable(new_uid)
            ),
        )

    provider.delete_orphan_variables()
    return result

def create_group_editor_contents(varid: str, active_project_id: str, project_provider: NewsegsProjectProviderInterface) -> list:
    """Create the group editor of a variable: a row for each group and one for a new value.

    Rows are ordered by their lowest configuration, so they don't move when the focus changes. The focussed group's value
    is edited in the main input, so it has no input here.

    Args:
        varid: Id of the variable.
        active_project_id: Id of the project.
        project_provider: Provider of the project.

    Returns:
        The children of the row's `input-group-editor` container.
    """
    provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, project_provider)
    lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
    groups = [x for x in get_variable_groups(lproj, varid) if x.var_uid is not None]
    if len(lproj.metamodels) <= 1 or not groups:
        return []
    lvars = {x.id: x for x in provider.variable_provider.get_lightweight_variable([cast(str, x.var_uid) for x in groups])}
    focussed_index = lproj.focussed_metamodel_index

    rows = []
    for group in groups:
        var_uid = cast(str, group.var_uid)
        lvar = lvars[var_uid]
        label = format_variable_value(lvar)
        is_focussed_group = focussed_index in group.metamodel_indices
        # Arrays are lists when read from the database; one of a single value is edited as a number
        raw_value = np.asarray(lvar.raw_parameter_0)
        is_scalar = raw_value.size == 1
        if is_focussed_group or not is_scalar:
            value = html.Span(f'{label} (edit above)' if is_focussed_group else label, className = 'group-editor-value-text')
        else:
            configs = ', '.join(str(i+1) for i in group.metamodel_indices)
            value = html.Label([
                html.Span(f'Value used by Config {configs}', className = 'visually-hidden'),
                dbc.Input(
                    id = group_value_input_id(varid, var_uid),
                    type = 'number',
                    value = raw_value.item(),
                    min = lvar.interface_min,
                    max = lvar.interface_max,
                    step = 'any',
                    debounce = True,
                    size = 'sm',
                    className = 'group-editor-value-input',
                ),
            ])
        rows.append(create_group_row(
            [html.Div(value, className = 'group-editor-value')],
            group, focussed_index, label, len(groups),
        ))

    return create_group_editor_frame(varid, SUPERSECTION, [html.Span('Value'), html.Span('Group')], rows)

def create_group_row(cells: list, group: VariableGroup, focussed_index: int, label: str, n_groups: int, className: str = ''):
    """Create a row of a group editor: its cells, then the group's configuration icons and its actions.

    Args:
        cells: The cells of the row: the group's values and settings.
        group: The group.
        focussed_index: Index of the focussed configuration.
        label: Short description of the group's value, for the confirmations and labels of buttons.
        n_groups: The number of groups of the variable; "Use for all" is offered when there are several.
        className: Further classes of the row.

    Returns:
        The row.
    """
    var_uid = cast(str, group.var_uid)
    actions = [_insert_button(var_uid, label)]
    if n_groups > 1:
        actions.append(html.Button(
            html.I(className = 'bi bi-arrows-angle-expand'),
            type = 'button',
            className = 'group-editor-all',
            title = 'Use for all',
            **{'data-target': var_uid, 'data-label': label, 'aria-label': f'Use {label} for all configurations'},
        ))
    is_focussed_group = focussed_index in group.metamodel_indices
    return html.Div(
        [
            *cells,
            # Wraps below the cells as one, when it doesn't fit beside them
            html.Div([
                html.Div([_icon_button(i, i == focussed_index) for i in group.metamodel_indices], className = 'group-editor-icons'),
                html.Div(actions, className = 'group-editor-actions'),
            ], className = 'group-editor-side'),
        ],
        className = ' '.join(x for x in ('group-editor-row', 'focussed' if is_focussed_group else '', className) if x),
        **{'data-var-uid': var_uid, 'data-label': label, 'data-size': str(len(group.metamodel_indices))},
    )

def get_icon(icon_name: None | SequenceNotStr[str] | str = None,
             icon_class: None | SequenceNotStr[str] | str = None,
             style_name: Literal['default', 'raw', 'unpadded'] = 'default'):

    # Icon for missing names:
    """Get an icon, or sequence of icons, by name.

    The icons are Bootstrap icon font classes. A sequence of names gives icons with padding classes such that they appear as one group. An unknown name gives a warning icon.

    Args:
        icon_name: Name(s) of the icon(s), from `components.icons`.
        icon_class: Further CSS classes of the icon.
        style_name: Padding style: `default`, `unpadded` or `raw` (the class names only).

    Returns:
        An `html.I` component, or with `style_name = "raw"` the class names.
    """
    mi = "bi bi-exclamation-circle"
    # The bootstrap pad and margin classes for default styles
    default_pad_class = 'p-1 m-2'
    left_sequence_pad_class = 'me-0 ms-2 py-1 pe-0 ps-1 my-2'
    mid_sequence_pad_class = 'py-1 px-0 my-2 mx-0'
    right_sequence_pad_class = 'py-1 pe-1 ps-0 my-2 me-2 ms-0'

    if not icon_name is None:
        if isinstance(icon_name, str):
            if icon_class is None:
                icon_class = ''
            elif not isinstance(icon_class, str):
                if len(icon_class) > 1:
                    raise ValueError(f'icon_class must match length of icon_name; icon_name is single string, icon_class is length {len(icon_class)}')
                icon_class = icon_class[0]

            fetched_icon = DEFAULT_ICONS.get(icon_name, mi)
            if style_name == 'raw':
                return fetched_icon

            if isinstance(fetched_icon, str):
                match style_name:
                    case 'default':
                        return html.I(className=' '.join([fetched_icon, default_pad_class, icon_class]).strip())
                    case 'unpadded':
                        return html.I(className=' '.join([fetched_icon, icon_class]).strip())
            else:
                ic = [' '.join([x, icon_class]).strip() for x in fetched_icon]
                return get_icon(icon_class = ic, style_name = style_name)

            return ""
        else:
            # Assume is sequence
            if len(icon_name) == 1:
                return get_icon(icon_name[0], icon_class, style_name)

            if not icon_class is None:
                if not isinstance(icon_class,str) and len(icon_class) > 1:
                    assert len(icon_class) == len(icon_name), 'If multiple icon_classes provided, must match length of icon_name'
                if isinstance(icon_class, str):
                    icon_class = [icon_class]
                if len(icon_class) == 1:
                    icon_class = list(icon_class) * len(icon_name)
            else:
                icon_class = [""] * len(icon_name)

            ilistraw = [get_icon(x, None, style_name = 'raw') for x in icon_name]
            # Some icons may be lists themselves. Run a quick expansion
            class_reps = flatten_string_lists.len_mixed_list(ilistraw)
            icon_class = flatten_string_lists.repeat_list_by_index(list(icon_class), class_reps)
            ilistraw = flatten_string_lists.flatten_mixed_list(ilistraw)

            match style_name:
                case 'raw':
                    return ilistraw
                case 'unpadded':
                    return html.Span([
                        html.I(className=' '.join([ilistraw[i], icon_class[i]]).strip()) for i in range(len(ilistraw))
                    ])
                case 'default':
                    ilist = []
                    for i in range(len(ilistraw)):
                        if i == 0 and len(ilistraw) > 1:
                            ilist.append(html.I(className=' '.join([ilistraw[i], left_sequence_pad_class ,icon_class[i]]).strip()))
                        elif i == (len(ilistraw)-1) and len(ilistraw) > 1:
                            ilist.append(html.I(className=' '.join([ilistraw[i], right_sequence_pad_class ,icon_class[i]]).strip()))
                        else:
                            ilist.append(html.I(className=' '.join([ilistraw[i], mid_sequence_pad_class ,icon_class[i]]).strip()))
                    return html.Span(ilist)

            return []
    else:
        if icon_class is None:
            raise ValueError('One of `icon_name` or `icon_class` must be provided')
        if isinstance(icon_class, str):
            match style_name:
                case 'raw':
                    return icon_class
                case 'unpadded':
                    return html.I(className=icon_class)
                case 'default':
                    return html.I(className=' '.join([icon_class, default_pad_class]))
            return ""
        else:
            if len(icon_class) == 1:
                return get_icon(icon_class = icon_class[0], style_name=style_name)

            match style_name:
                case 'raw':
                    return icon_class
                case 'unpadded':
                    return html.Span([
                        html.I(className=x) for x in icon_class
                    ])
                case 'default':
                    ilist = []
                    for i in range(len(icon_class)):
                        if i == 0:
                            ilist.append(html.I(className=' '.join([left_sequence_pad_class, icon_class[i]]).strip()))
                        elif i == (len(icon_class)-1):
                            ilist.append(html.I(className=' '.join([right_sequence_pad_class, icon_class[i]]).strip()))
                        else:
                            ilist.append(html.I(className=' '.join([mid_sequence_pad_class, icon_class[i]]).strip()))
                    return html.Span(ilist)

    return []

def create_numeric_variable_parameter_input(
    param_id: VariableInstanceParameterComponentID,
    placeholder: int | float | str = 0.0,
    value: int | float | None = None,
    min: int | float | None = 0.0,
    max: int | float | None = None,
    step: int | float  = 1
):
    """Create a numeric field for a parameter of a variable.

    The field steps dynamically according to the step, and its id is that of the parameter.

    Args:
        param_id: Identification of the variable parameter that the component edits.
        placeholder: Placeholder shown when the field is empty.
        value: The value.
        min: Minimum value of the field.
        max: Maximum value of the field.
        step: Step of the field.

    Returns:
        The input.
    """
    input_id = param_id.as_dict()

    if float(int(step)) == float(step):
        step = int(step)
        cn = f'dynamic-step-field step-val-{step:d}'
    else:
        cn = f'dynamic-step-field step-val-{step:f}'

    return dbc.Input(
        id = input_id,
        type = 'number',
        value = value,
        placeholder = placeholder,
        min = min,
        max = max,
        step = 'any',
        className = cn,
        debounce = True,
    )

@register_input_handler('parameter', 'single-input-config')
def update_single_parameter(
    triggered_id: dict,
    input_ids: list[dict[str, str]],
    header_ids: list[dict[str, str]],
    trigger_ids: list[dict[str, str]],
    calling_dict: dict,
    active_project_id: str,
    project_provider: NewsegsProjectProviderInterface,
    return_dict: dict[str, Any],
    new_val: Optional[Any] = None, # Include this so we can call from other parameter setting functions, not just dash callbacks
) -> dict[str, Any]:

    """Input handler for a change in a single parameter of a variable.

    Updates the variable of the active project with the new value, and sets the outputs of the callback according to what the change affected - the deterministic value, the DSA bounds and the PSA statistics. Registered for the purpose `parameter` of `single-input-config` components.

    Args:
        triggered_id: The id of the component which triggered the callback.
        input_ids: The ids of the input components of the callback.
        header_ids: The ids of the header containers of the callback.
        trigger_ids: The ids of the trigger stores of the callback.
        calling_dict: Other keyword arguments of the calling callback.
        active_project_id: Id of the active project.
        project_provider: Provider of projects, metamodels and variables.
        return_dict: Dictionary of the outputs of the callback, to be updated and returned.
        new_val: The new value; by default the value of the triggering component.

    Returns:
        The updated `return_dict`.
    """
    if new_val is None:
        new_val = callback_utils.get_triggered_value()
        if new_val is None:
            new_val = 0

    variable_keys = {k: triggered_id.get(k) for k in VARIABLE_PARAMETER_KEYS}
    varid = make_varid(**variable_keys)
    update_variable_keys = {k: v for k,v in variable_keys.items() if k in {'parameter_index', 'vector_location'}}

    provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, project_provider)
    logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Updating a single parameter')
    lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
    lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]

    var_instance_id = lmm.variables[varid]
    var = provider.variable_provider.get_variable(var_instance_id)

    now = time.time_ns()

    update_ok, deterministic_changed, dsa_changed, psa_changed, raw_params = apply_parameter_change(
        provider, lproj, var, new_val, **update_variable_keys
    )

    # Feed back current parameters
    for idx, id in enumerate(input_ids):
        if id['purpose'] == 'parameter':
            pi = id['parameter_index']
            new_param = raw_params[pi] # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue, reportArgumentType]
            if not isinstance(new_param, np.ndarray):
                return_dict['input_values'][idx] = new_param
            else:
                vi = id['vector_location']
                new_val = new_param.flat[vi] # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType, reportCallIssue]
                return_dict['input_values'][idx] = new_val

    # Update headers
    for idx, id in enumerate(header_ids):
        try:
            content_creator = get_single_input_header_content_creator(
                id['supersection'], id['section'], lmm.model.model_type
            )
        except KeyError:
            content_creator = None
        if content_creator:
            return_dict['header_children'][idx] = content_creator(varid, var)

    # Update triggers
    for idx, id in enumerate(trigger_ids):
        match id['supersection']:
            case 'deterministic':
                if deterministic_changed:
                    return_dict['trigger_data'][idx] = now
            case 'dsa':
                if dsa_changed:
                    return_dict['trigger_data'][idx] = now
            case 'psa':
                if psa_changed:
                    return_dict['trigger_data'][idx] = now

    if update_ok:
        _signal_summary_refresh(return_dict, now)

    return return_dict

def apply_parameter_change(
    provider: FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider,
    lproj: LightweightNewsegsProject,
    var,
    new_val: Any,
    parameter_index: int = 0,
    vector_location: int = 0,
) -> tuple[bool, bool, bool, bool, Any]:
    """Change a parameter of a variable of a project, and save it if the value is accepted.

    The configurations using the variable, their tables and the project are revised, and the processes the change
    affects are marked stale for those configurations. The variable need not be that of the focussed configuration.

    Args:
        provider: Provider of the project.
        lproj: The lightweight project.
        var: The variable.
        new_val: The new value.
        parameter_index: Index of the parameter.
        vector_location: Position within an array parameter.

    Returns:
        As `update_variable`: whether the value was accepted, whether the deterministic value, the DSA bounds and the
        PSA statistics changed, and the raw parameters, which are those saved if the value was rejected.
    """
    update_ok, deterministic_changed, dsa_changed, psa_changed, raw_params = update_variable(
        var, value = new_val, parameter_index = parameter_index, vector_location = vector_location
    )
    if update_ok:
        # Sync the variable
        provider.variable_provider.upsert_variable(var)

        # Mark the model components as revised
        table_components_to_revise = []
        metamodels_to_revise = []
        for mm in lproj.metamodels:
            if var.id in set(mm.variables.values()):
                table_components_to_revise.append(mm.table_config.id)
                table_components_to_revise.append(mm.model.table_config.id)
                table_components_to_revise.append(mm.finance.table_config.id)
                metamodels_to_revise.append(mm.id)
        table_components_to_revise.append(lproj.table_config.id)

        provider._component_provider.increment_revision(table_components_to_revise)
        provider.metamodel_provider.increment_revision(metamodels_to_revise)
        provider.increment_revision(lproj.id)

        db_staleness.mark_inputs_changed(
            metamodels_to_revise,
            staleness.processes_affected(deterministic_changed, dsa_changed, psa_changed),
        )
    return update_ok, deterministic_changed, dsa_changed, psa_changed, raw_params

docs.text:
Create a row which builds its editor only when it is opened.

The row is a Details holding a Summary, whose clicks are counted by react_to_input_change, and an empty input-group-editor container. An odd count opens the row, and the editor content creator registered for the supersection and section of param_id (see registers.register_input_editor_content_creator) fills the container. Reopening the row builds the editor again, so that it shows the current values.

The row also holds a hidden single-input-config with the purpose editor-anchor. The Dash renderer only calls react_to_input_change for a row with a component matching its first output, and the editor's inputs don't exist until it is built. No handler writes to the anchor, and its value never changes.

Redraw only the children of the editor container, never the Details or the Summary: a new Summary restarts the count while the Details stays as it was, and the count and the open state then disagree. Rebuilding the whole input container is safe, since it resets both.

Don't put interactive components in the Summary: clicks on them are counted too.

The children of the summary, shown whether the row is open or closed.

def create_lazy_input_details(
    summary_children: Any,
    param_id: VariableInstanceParameterComponentID,
    className: str | None = None,
) -> html.Details:
    """Create a row which builds its editor only when it is opened.

    The row is a `Details` holding a `Summary`, whose clicks are counted by `react_to_input_change`, and an empty
    `input-group-editor` container. An odd count opens the row, and the editor content creator registered for the
    supersection and section of `param_id` (see `registers.register_input_editor_content_creator`) fills the container.
    Reopening the row builds the editor again, so that it shows the current values.

    The row also holds a hidden `single-input-config` with the purpose `editor-anchor`. The Dash renderer only calls
    `react_to_input_change` for a row with a component matching its first output, and the editor's inputs don't exist
    until it is built. No handler writes to the anchor, and its value never changes.

    Redraw only the children of the editor container, never the `Details` or the `Summary`: a new `Summary` restarts the
    count while the `Details` stays as it was, and the count and the open state then disagree. Rebuilding the whole input
    container is safe, since it resets both.

    Don't put interactive components in the `Summary`: clicks on them are counted too.

    Args:
        summary_children: The children of the summary, shown whether the row is open or closed.
        param_id: Identification of the variable parameter that the row edits.
        className: Class of the `Details`.

    Returns:
        The row.
    """
    summary_id = copy.copy(param_id)
    summary_id.type = 'input-summary'
    summary_id.purpose = 'group-editor-toggle'

    editor_id = copy.copy(param_id)
    editor_id.type = 'input-group-editor'
    editor_id.purpose = 'editor'

    anchor_id = copy.copy(param_id)
    anchor_id.type = 'single-input-config'
    anchor_id.purpose = 'editor-anchor'

    return html.Details(
        [
            html.Summary(summary_children, id = summary_id.as_dict()),
            html.Div([], id = editor_id.as_dict()),
            dcc.Input(id = anchor_id.as_dict(), type = 'hidden'),
        ],
        className = className,
    )

def get_variable_groups(proj: LightweightNewsegsProject, varid: str) -> list[VariableGroup]:
    """Group the configurations of a project by the instance of a variable that they hold.

    Args:
        proj: The lightweight project.
        varid: Id of the variable.

    Returns:
        The groups, ordered by their lowest configuration index, so that they keep their order when the focus changes.
        The configurations without the variable form a group with no `var_uid`.
    """
    indices_by_uid: dict[str | None, list[int]] = {}
    for idx, lmm in enumerate(proj.metamodels):
        indices_by_uid.setdefault(lmm.variables.get(varid), []).append(idx)
    groups = [VariableGroup(uid, tuple(indices)) for uid, indices in indices_by_uid.items()]
    return sorted(groups, key = lambda x: x.metamodel_indices[0])

def format_variable_value(var: LightweightVariable | None) -> str:
    """The value of a variable, as its sharing summary shows it.

    Args:
        var: The variable, or None for a configuration without it.

    Returns:
        The value shown in its input (the first raw parameter), the number of values of an array, or `–`.
    """
    if var is None:
        return '–'
    value = var.raw_parameter_0
    # Arrays are lists when read from the database
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, np.ndarray)):
        value = np.asarray(value)
        if value.size != 1:
            return f'{value.size} values'
        value = value.item()
    if isinstance(value, (int, float, np.number)):
        return f'{value:,.6g}'
    return str(value)

def create_variable_sharing_summary_contents(
    proj: LightweightNewsegsProject,
    varid: str,
    variables: Mapping[str, LightweightVariable],
) -> list:
    """Create what the sharing summary of an input shows.

    Nothing for a project with one configuration; a link icon when every configuration shares the variable; otherwise a
    line with each group's configurations and value, emphasising the group of the focussed configuration.

    Args:
        proj: The lightweight project.
        varid: Id of the variable.
        variables: The variables of the project, by id; it needs only those of the groups.

    Returns:
        The children of the summary.
    """
    if len(proj.metamodels) <= 1:
        return []
    groups = get_variable_groups(proj, varid)
    if len(groups) == 1:
        return [html.I(className = get_icon('config-shared', style_name = 'raw'), title = 'Shared by every configuration')]

    focussed_index = proj.focussed_metamodel_index
    line = []
    for group in groups:
        if line:
            line.append(' · ')
        class_name = 'variable-sharing-group'
        if focussed_index in group.metamodel_indices:
            class_name += ' focussed'
        value = format_variable_value(variables.get(group.var_uid) if group.var_uid else None)
        line.append(html.Span([*_config_icons(group.metamodel_indices), ' ', value], className = class_name))
    return line

def create_input_card(
    supersection: str,
    section: str,
    title: list[dash.development.base_component.Component | str],
    className: str | None = None
):
    """Create a card to hold inputs.

    The body is an input container, filled by callbacks with the inputs registered for the supersection and section. The
    title has a label counting the inputs whose configurations differ, which stays visible when the inputs are collapsed.

    Args:
        supersection: The supersection (e.g. the page or group of inputs).
        section: The interface section of the variable.
        title: Title of the card.
        className: Further CSS classes.

    Returns:
        The card.
    """
    if className is not None:
        container_class_name = 'input-container ' + className
    else:
        container_class_name = 'input-container'

    return dbc.Card([
        dbc.CardBody([
            html.H2(
                [
                    *title,
                    # The number of inputs whose configurations differ, outside the collapsible inputs
                    html.Span(
                        id = {'type': 'input-card-label', 'supersection': supersection, 'section': section},
                        className = 'input-card-label',
                    ),
                ],
                className='card-title'
            ),

            dcc.Loading(
                html.H4(
                    id = {'type': 'input-section-header', 'supersection': supersection, 'section': section},
                    className='card-subtitle'
                ),
                delay_show = 500,
                delay_hide = 500,
                overlay_style={"visibility":"visible", "filter": "blur(1px)"},
                custom_spinner=html.H1(''),
            ),


            html.Details([
                html.Summary(""),
                dcc.Loading(
                    html.Div(
                        id = {'type': 'input-container', 'supersection': supersection, 'section': section},
                        className = container_class_name
                    ),
                    delay_show = 500,
                    delay_hide = 500,
                    overlay_style={"visibility":"visible", "filter": "blur(1px)"},
                    custom_spinner=html.H1(''),
                )

            ]),

            dcc.Interval(
                id = {
                    'type': 'input-container-hydration-interval', 
                    'supersection': supersection, 
                    'section': section
                },
                n_intervals = 1,
                disabled = False,
                max_intervals = 1,
                interval = 50,
            )
        ])
    ])

def create_results_container(
    children = [],
    section: str = 'results',
    supersection: str = 'results',
    className: str = ''
):
    """The highest level of results component. Blurs on activity and has a spinner.

    A type = 'results-container' holds both a 'results-content', which holds the actual
    results children, and a 'results-overlay', which holds the spinner and has no id.

    The className argument can be used to add extra classes to the results-container
    """
    cn = 'results-container'
    if className:
        cn +=  ' ' + className

    return html.Div(
        id = {"type": "results-container", "section": section, "supersection": supersection},
        className = cn,
        children = [
            # Layer A: Actual Content (blurs when calculating)
            html.Div(
                id={"type": "results-content", 'section': section, "supersection": supersection},
                className = "results-content",
                children = children,
            ),
            # Layer B: Spinner Overlay (fades in over the top)
            html.Div(
                children=[
                    html.Div(className="spinner"),
                    html.P(
                        "Computing...",
                        id = {
                            'type': 'results-overlay-text',
                            'section': section,
                            'supersection': supersection
                        },
                        className="results-overlay-title"
                    ),
                    html.Small(
                        '',
                        id = {
                            'type': 'results-overlay-subtext',
                            'section': section,
                            'supersection': supersection
                        },
                        className="results-overlay-subtext"
                    ),

                    dbc.Progress(
                        id={
                            'type': 'results-progress-bar',
                            'section': section,
                            'supersection': supersection
                        },
                        value=100,
                        animated=True,
                        striped=True,
                        className="results-progress"
                    ),

                    dbc.Button(
                        "Cancel Jobs",
                        id = {
                            'type': 'cancel-job-button',
                            'section': section,
                            'supersection': supersection,
                        }
                    ),
                ],
                className="results-overlay"
            )
        ],
        # Default data attribute state
        **{"data-status": "IDLE"}, # type: ignore
    )
