def create_results_table_card(
    supersection: str,
    section: str,
    key: str = 'toplevel',
    title: list[dash.development.base_component.Component | str] = [''],
    className: str | None = None,
    header_section: str | None = None,
    header_key: str | None = None,
):
    """Create a card to hold a table of results.

    The body is a container filled by callbacks with the results registered for the supersection and section.

    Args:
        supersection: The supersection (e.g. the page or group of inputs).
        section: The interface section of the variable.
        key: The interface key of the variable.
        title: Title of the card.
        className: Further CSS classes.
        header_section: Section of the header; that of the card by default.
        header_key: Key of the header; that of the card by default.

    Returns:
        The card.
    """
    header_section = section if header_section is None else header_section
    header_key = key if header_key is None else header_key
    if className is not None:
        container_class_name = 'result-container ' + className
    else:
        container_class_name = 'result-container'

    return dbc.Card([
        dbc.CardBody([
            html.H2(
                title, 
                className='card-title'
            ),

            html.H4(
                id = {
                    'type': 'result-section-header', 'purpose': 'header',
                    'supersection': supersection, 'section': header_section,
                    'key': header_key, 'subindex': 0
                },
                className='card-subtitle'
            ),

            html.Div(
                id = {
                    'type': 'result-container', 'purpose': 'container',
                    'supersection': supersection, 'section': section,
                    'key': key, 'subindex': 0
                },
                className = container_class_name
            ),
        ]) # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue]
    ],
    ) # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue]

def create_result_grid(
    records: list[dict],
    n_configs: int,
    grid_id: dict,
    none_str: str = '-'
) -> dag.AgGrid:
    """
    Render records from the stats *_records functions as an AG Grid.

    Configurations missing from the records are shown as none_str. Clicks on
    zoomable date cells arrive through the grid's `cellClicked` prop; give
    grid_id a 'type' of 'result-grid' to have them zoom the timeseries.
    """
    config_keys = [f'config-{x+1}' for x in range(n_configs)]
    records = [{k: none_str for k in config_keys} | rec for rec in records]
    label_fields = [x for x in _LABEL_FIELDS if records and x in records[0]]

    column_defs = [
        {
            'field': field,
            'headerName': '',
            'wrapText': True,
            **_LABEL_FIELDS[field],
        } for field in label_fields
    ]
    if 'statistic' in label_fields:
        column_defs[-1]['cellStyle'] = {'function': "params.data._align_end ? {textAlign: 'end'} : null"}

    column_defs += [
        {
            'field': key,
            'headerComponent': 'ResultConfigHeader',
            'headerComponentParams': {'iconClassName': _config_icon_class(x)},
            'cellDataType': False,
            'flex': 2,
            'minWidth': 120,
            'wrapText': True,
            'valueFormatter': {'function': f"{_JS_IS_ZOOM_CELL} ? params.value.label : params.value"},
            'cellStyle': {'function': (
                f"{_JS_IS_ZOOM_CELL} ? "
                "{cursor: 'zoom-in', lineHeight: '1.4', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center'} : null"
            )},
        } for x, key in enumerate(config_keys)
    ]

    return dag.AgGrid(
        id = grid_id,
        rowData = records,
        columnDefs = column_defs,
        defaultColDef = {
            'sortable': False,
            'suppressMovable': True,
            'resizable': True,
        },
        dashGridOptions = {
            'enableCellSpan': True,
            'domLayout': 'autoHeight',
            'suppressCellFocus': True,
            'getRowHeight': {'function': f"params.data._wrap ? {_WRAP_ROW_HEIGHT} : null"},
        },
        style = {'height': None},
    )

def create_map_layout(map_id='sitemap',
                      center=(53.165716, -3.728402)):
    """Create the site map.

    A Leaflet map with a tile layer, on which a site can be chosen.

    Args:

    return [
        dl.Map(
            id=map_id,
            children=[
                dl.TileLayer(),
                dl.LayerGroup(id='other-metamodels-container'),
                dl.LayerGroup(id='site-marker-container'),
                dl.LayerGroup(id='site-confirm-container'),
            ],
            center=center,
            zoom=9,
            doubleClickZoom=False,
            style={"height":"33vh"},
        ),
        dcc.Store(id='potential-site-location'),
        dcc.Store(id='site-location')
        ]

def add_latlon_sync_callbacks(app: NewsegsDash):
    """Bind the callback which updates the site location from the latitude and longitude fields.

    Args:
        app: The Dash app.
    """
    @app.callback(
        Output('site-location', 'data', allow_duplicate=True),

        Input('site-lat-input', 'value'),
        Input('site-lon-input', 'value'),
        Input('site-name-input', 'value'),
        State('site-location', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call=True
    )
    def sync_inputs_to_store(lat_val, lon_val, site_name, current_site):
        if lat_val is None or lon_val is None or site_name is None:
            return no_update
        try:
            lat = float(lat_val)
            lon = float(lon_val)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return no_update
        if not (-90 <= lat <= 90 and -180 <= lon <= 180):
            return no_update
        easting,northing = _trans_togb.transform(lat, lon)
        new_site = {'lat': lat, 'lon': lon, 'easting': easting, 'northing': northing, 'name': site_name}
        metamodel_id = _site_metamodel_id(current_site)
        if metamodel_id:
            new_site['metamodel_id'] = metamodel_id
        new_site = json.dumps(new_site)
        logger.debug(
            'Site location inputs syncronised to store: lat/lon: (%s, %s); OSGB: (%s, %s)',
            lat, lon, easting, northing
        )
        if new_site == current_site:
            return no_update
        return new_site

    @app.callback(
        Output('site-lat-input', 'value'),
        Output('site-lon-input', 'value'),
        Output('site-name-input', 'value'),
        Output('staleness-update-trigger', 'data', allow_duplicate = True),

        Input('site-location', 'data'),
        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call=True
    )
    def sync_store_to_inputs(site_loc, active_project_id):
        if site_loc is None:
            raise PreventUpdate
        try:
            coords = json.loads(site_loc)
            lat = round(float(coords.get('lat', '')), 6)
            lon = round(float(coords.get('lon', '')), 6)
            name = coords.get('name', no_update)
        except (TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError):
            raise PreventUpdate

        newloc = modlocation.Location(lat, lon, name = name)

        provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
        logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Updating configuration location to map location')
        lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
        lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]

        # A location still queued from the previously focussed configuration
        # must not be written to the newly focussed one
        if coords.get('metamodel_id', lmm.id) != lmm.id:
            logger.debug(
                'Ignoring site location for Metamodel ID %s; focussed Metamodel ID is %s',
                coords.get('metamodel_id'), lmm.id
            )
            raise PreventUpdate

        modified = False
        staleness_update = no_update
        oldloc = copy.copy(lmm.location)
        if not(newloc == lmm.location):
            lmm.location = newloc
            modified = True
        if not lmm.location.name == name:
            lmm.location.name = name
            modified = True

        if modified:
            model_provider = cast(
                FromDatabaseNewsegsEMProvider,
                provider.metamodel_provider._em_provider
                )
            mdl = model_provider.get_component(lmm.model.id)
            mdl.location = lmm.location
            model_provider.upsert_component(mdl, force = True, project_id = active_project_id)
            app.project_provider.metamodel_provider.set_component_metadata(
                lmm.id,
                'location',
                json.dumps(mdl.location.to_dict())
            )
            provider.metamodel_provider.set_component_metadata(
                lmm.id, 'lat', mdl.location.lat, increment_revision = False, project_id = active_project_id
            )
            provider.metamodel_provider.set_component_metadata(
                lmm.id, 'lon', mdl.location.lon, increment_revision = False, project_id = active_project_id,
            )
            provider.increment_revision(lproj.id)
            provider.metamodel_provider.increment_revision(lmm.id)
            provider._component_provider.increment_revision(
                [
                    lproj.table_config.id,
                    lmm.table_config.id,
                    lmm.model.table_config.id,
                    lmm.finance.table_config.id,
                ]
            )

            logger.info(
                'Location changed for Metamodel ID %s; %s -> %s',
                lmm.id, oldloc, lmm.location
            )

            # Renaming the site alone has no effect on results
            if (oldloc.lat, oldloc.lon) != (lmm.location.lat, lmm.location.lon):
                db_staleness.mark_inputs_changed(lmm.id, staleness.processes_affected(deterministic = True))
                staleness_update = time.time_ns()

        return f"{lat:.6f}", f"{lon:.6f}", name, staleness_update

def add_map_click_callback(app: NewsegsDash):
    """Bind the callback which proposes a new site location when the map is double clicked.

    Args:
        app: The Dash app.
    """
    @app.callback(
        Output('potential-site-location', 'data'),

        Input('sitemap', 'dblclickData'),
        State('potential-site-location', 'data'),
        State('site-name-input', 'value'),
        prevent_initial_call=True
    )
    def change_site_loc(click_data, current_val, current_name):
        if not current_val is None:
            coords = json.loads(current_val)
            pos = [float(coords['lat']), float(coords['lon'])]
            if pos[0] == 0 and pos[1] == 0:
                return []
        if not click_data is None:
            coordinates = click_data.get('latlng')
            if not coordinates:
                raise PreventUpdate
            lat, lon = coordinates.values()
            easting,northing = _trans_togb.transform(float(lat), float(lon))
            logger.debug('Potential site location change to lat/lon: (%s, %s); OSGB: (%s, %s)',
                         lat, lon, easting, northing)
            return json.dumps({'lat':lat,'lon':lon, 'easting': easting, 'northing': northing, 'name': current_name})
        else:
            return json.dumps({'lat':0,'lon':0, 'name': current_name})

def add_site_change_callback(app) -> Dash:
    """Bind the callback which moves the site marker and updates the OSGB feedback when the site location changes.

    Args:
        app: The Dash app.

    Returns:
        The app.
    """
    @app.callback(
        Output('site-marker-container', 'children'),
        Output('site-osgb-easting-text', 'children'),
        Output('site-osgb-northing-text', 'children'),
        Output('other-metamodels-container', 'children'),

        Input('site-location', 'data'),
        State('active-project-id', 'data'),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def add_site_marker(json_latlon, active_project_id):
        coords = json.loads(json_latlon)
        pos = [float(coords['lat']), float(coords['lon'])]
        easting = coords.get('easting', None)
        northing = coords.get('northing', None)
        if not easting:
            easting, northing = _trans_togb.transform(pos[0], pos[1])

        logger.debug(
            'Site location is lat/lon: (%s, %s); OSGB: (%s, %s)',
            pos[0], pos[1], easting, northing
        )

        # Active focussed marker
        focussed_marker = [
            dl.Marker(
                id='site-marker',
                position=pos,
                children=[dl.Tooltip("Site location")]
            )
        ]

        # Non-focussed metamodel markers (translucent)
        other_markers = []
        if active_project_id:
            try:
                provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, app.project_provider)
                logger.debug('Getting lightweight project - Getting locations of all project metamodels for map')
                lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
                lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]

                for mm in lproj.metamodels:
                    if mm != lmm and mm.location:
                        loc = mm.location
                        lat = loc.lat
                        lon = loc.lon
                        if lat and lon:
                            other_markers.append(
                                dl.Marker(
                                    position=[lat, lon],
                                    opacity=0.4,
                                    children=[
                                        dl.Tooltip(loc.display_name)
                                    ]
                                )
                            )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.exception('Could not draw non-focussed metamodel markers', exc_info = True)
                pass

        return (
            focussed_marker,
            f"{float(easting):,.0f}",
            f"{float(northing):,.0f}",
            other_markers
        )
    return app

def create_navigator_buttons(
        model_type: str = 'default',
        pages: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    ):
    """Create the navigation buttons of pages, and the button linking to the documentation.

    All registered pages unless `pages` lists those to show.

    Args:
        model_type: The model type (e.g. `sprake`); `default` for the fallback.
        pages: See the description.

    Returns:
        List of buttons.
    """
    if pages is None:
        pages = [x for x in registers.PAGE_REGISTER.keys()]
    page_objs = [registers.get_page(x) for x in pages]
    return [
        create_newsegs_model_navbutton(
            model_type,
            x.id,
            x.nav_label,
            x.nav_icon
        ) for x in page_objs
    ] + [create_docs_button()]

def create_navigation_component(
        model_type: str = 'default',
        pages: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    ):
    """Create the navigation bar: a toggle button and a collapsible drawer of navigation buttons.

    The drawer is collapsed until the toggle is clicked. It opens as a row when the four-pane
    layout is side by side and as a column when the panes are stacked (see
    `src/styles/20-navigation.css`), sized to fit all of its buttons.

    Args:
        model_type: The model type (e.g. `sprake`); `default` for the fallback.
        pages: See the description.

    Returns:
        The navigation bar.
    """
    buttons = create_navigator_buttons(model_type, pages)
    return html.Div(
        [
            create_nav_toggle(),
            html.Div(
                buttons,
                id = NAV_DRAWER_ID,
                className = 'newsegs-nav-drawer',
                # Sizes the open drawer to fit all the buttons, so that it animates to its full size
                style = {'--nav-button-count': len(buttons)},
            ),
        ],
        id = 'navbar',
        className = NAVBAR_CLASS,
    )

def add_navigation_callbacks(app):
    """Bind the callback which expands and collapses the navigation drawer.

    Client side, as it only toggles a class.

    Args:
        app: The Dash app.
    """
    app.clientside_callback(
        f"""
        function(n_clicks, className) {{
            const expanded = !(className || '').split(' ').includes('expanded');
            return [
                expanded ? '{NAVBAR_EXPANDED_CLASS}' : '{NAVBAR_CLASS}',
                expanded ? 'true' : 'false',
            ];
        }}
        """,
        Output('navbar', 'className'),
        Output(NAV_TOGGLE_ID, 'aria-expanded'),
        Input(NAV_TOGGLE_ID, 'n_clicks'),
        State('navbar', 'className'),
        prevent_initial_call = True,
    )

def fetch_project_options(

    """Obtains available projects"""
    all_projects = project_provider.list_projects(model_type = model_type).to_dict(orient = 'list')

def load_snapshot(
    project_provider: NewsegsProjectProviderInterface,
    current_project_id: str,
    snapshot_id: str
) -> str | None:
    """Restore a snapshot of the current project as a new project.

    Args:
        project_provider: Provider of projects, metamodels and variables.
        current_project_id: Id of the current project.
        snapshot_id: Id of the snapshot.

    Returns:
        The id of the new project, or None if the snapshot is not found.
    """
    int_snapshot_id = int(snapshot_id)
    all_snapshots = project_provider.list_project_snapshots(current_project_id)
    if not np.any(all_snapshots['snapshot_id'] == int_snapshot_id):
        return None
    snapshot_label = all_snapshots.loc[all_snapshots['snapshot_id']==int_snapshot_id,'label'].iloc[0]
    new_proj = project_provider.load_project_snapshot(
        current_project_id, int_snapshot_id
    )
    rename_project(project_provider, new_proj.id, f'{new_proj.name} from {snapshot_label}')
    return new_proj.id

def delete_project(
    project_provider: NewsegsProjectProviderInterface,
    delete_project_id: str,
    active_project_id: str,
    model_type: str,
) -> str | None:
    """Delete a project.

    Raises `ValueError` if it cannot be deleted.

    Args:
        project_provider: Provider of projects, metamodels and variables.
        delete_project_id: Id of the project to delete.
        active_project_id: Id of the active project.
        model_type: The model type (e.g. `sprake`); `default` for the fallback.

    Returns:
        The id of the project to make active: the active one if a different project was deleted; otherwise another.
    """
    returned = project_provider.delete_component(delete_project_id)
    if returned:
        raise ValueError('Project could not be deleted')
    if delete_project_id != active_project_id:
        return active_project_id

    proj_options = fetch_project_options(project_provider, model_type)
    if proj_options:
        return proj_options[0].get('value')

    return None

def ui_state_triggers(triggers: list[callback_utils.Trigger]) -> set[str]:
    """The triggers of the project selector's state callback to act on.

    Every trigger is considered, as several may fire together, such as the active project and the app state on a
    change of page. A change of the active project resets the project and snapshot selectors and name inputs, and a
    change of the app state the project ones, so changes of those inputs in the same call are ignored.

    Args:
        triggers: The triggers of the callback.

    Returns:
        The ids of the triggers to act on.
    """
    ids = {x.id for x in triggers if isinstance(x.id, str)}
    if 'active-project-id' in ids:
        ids -= _SNAPSHOT_INPUT_IDS
    if ids & {'active-project-id', 'app-state'}:
        ids -= _PROJECT_INPUT_IDS
    return ids

def add_project_selector_callbacks(app: NewsegsDash):
    """Bind the callbacks of the project selector.

    Args:
        app: The Dash app.
    """
    @app.callback(
        Output("collapse-controls", "is_open"),
        Input("btn-toggle-controls", "n_clicks"),
        State("collapse-controls", "is_open"),
        prevent_initial_call=True,
    )
    def toggle_controls(n_clicks, is_open):
        return not is_open if n_clicks else is_open

    def _disable_project_load_buttons(state: bool, rval):
        # As no project selected, disable the load and delete buttons
        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
            {'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'load-project'},
            'disabled',
            state,
            rval
        )
        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
            {'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'delete-project'},
            'disabled',
            state,
            rval
        )

    def _disable_project_rename_button(state: bool, rval):
        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                {'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'rename-project'},
                'disabled',
                state,
                rval
            )

    def _disable_snapshot_rename_button(state: bool, rval):
        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
            {'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'rename-snapshot'},
            'disabled',
            state,
            rval
        )

    def _disable_snapshot_load_buttons(state: bool, rval):
        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
            {'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'load-snapshot'},
            'disabled',
            state,
            rval
        )
        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
            {'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'delete-snapshot'},
            'disabled',
            state,
            rval
        )

    def _disable_snapshot_create_button(state: bool, rval):
        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
            {'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'create-snapshot'},
            'disabled',
            state,
            rval
        )

    @app.callback(
        output = dict(
            header_project_name = Output('header-project-name', 'children'),
            project_select = dict(
                value = Output('select-load-project', 'value'),
                options = Output('select-load-project', 'options')
            ),
            snapshot_select = dict(
                value = Output('select-load-snapshot', 'value'),
                options = Output('select-load-snapshot', 'options')
            ),
            input_project_name = dict(
                value =  Output('input-project-name', 'value'),
            ),
            input_snapshot_name = dict(
                value =  Output('input-snapshot-name', 'value'),
            ),
            buttons = dict (
                button_disabled = Output({'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': ALL}, 'disabled'),
                button_class = Output({'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': ALL}, 'class_name'),
            )
        ),
        inputs = dict(
            active_project_id = Input('active-project-id', 'data'),
            app_state = Input('app-state', 'data'),
            select_project = Input('select-load-project', 'value'),
            select_snapshot = Input('select-load-snapshot', 'value'),
            input_project_name = Input('input-project-name', 'value'),
            input_snapshot_name = Input('input-snapshot-name', 'value'),

        ),

        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def update_ui_states(
        active_project_id,
        app_state,
        select_project,
        select_snapshot,
        input_project_name,
        input_snapshot_name,
    ):

        rval = callback_utils.create_noupdate_return()

        triggered = ui_state_triggers(callback_utils.get_triggers())
        if 'active-project-id' in triggered:
            rval['header_project_name'] = app.project_provider.get_component_metadata(active_project_id, 'label')['label']

            # Update snapshot selector
            all_snapshots = fetch_snapshot_options(app.project_provider, active_project_id)
            rval['snapshot_select']['options'] = all_snapshots
            rval['snapshot_select']['value'] = None

            # As no snapshot selected, disable the load, rename and delete buttons
            _disable_snapshot_load_buttons(True, rval)

            # Also clear the name input
            rval['input_snapshot_name']['value'] = None
            _disable_snapshot_create_button(True, rval)
            _disable_snapshot_rename_button(True, rval)

        if triggered & {'active-project-id', 'app-state'}:
            # Update project selector
            app_state = json.loads(app_state) if app_state else {}
            model_type = app_state.get('model_type', 'default')
            all_projects = fetch_project_options(app.project_provider, model_type)
            rval['project_select']['options'] = all_projects
            rval['project_select']['value'] = None

            # As no project selected, disable the load and delete buttons
            _disable_project_load_buttons(True, rval)

            # Also clear the name input
            rval['input_project_name']['value'] = None
            _disable_project_rename_button(True, rval)

        if 'select-load-project' in triggered:
            project_nominated = select_project is not None
            _disable_project_load_buttons(not(project_nominated), rval)

        if 'input-project-name' in triggered:
            new_project_name = input_project_name
            _disable_project_rename_button((new_project_name is None or not new_project_name), rval)

        if triggered & {'select-load-snapshot', 'input-snapshot-name'}:
            snapshot_nominated = select_snapshot is not None
            new_snapshot_name = input_snapshot_name is not None and input_snapshot_name != ''
            if 'select-load-snapshot' in triggered:
                _disable_snapshot_load_buttons(not(snapshot_nominated), rval)
            if 'input-snapshot-name' in triggered:
                _disable_snapshot_create_button(not new_snapshot_name, rval)
            _disable_snapshot_rename_button(not(snapshot_nominated and new_snapshot_name), rval)

        return rval

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Event Action Callbacks (Create, Load, Delete, Snapshot)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    @app.callback(
        output = dict(
            active_project_id = Output("active-project-id", "data", allow_duplicate = True),
        ),
        # Triggers
        inputs = dict(
            buttons = dict(
                n_clicks = Input({'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': ALL}, 'n_clicks')
            ),
            delete_project_confirm = Input('delete-project-confirm-dialog', 'submit_n_clicks'),
            delete_snapshot_confirm = Input('delete-snapshot-confirm-dialog', 'submit_n_clicks'),
        ),

        state = dict(
            active_project_id = State('active-project-id', 'data'),
            session_id = State('session-id', 'data'),
            app_state = State('app-state', 'data'),
            input_project_name = State('input-project-name', 'value'),
            input_snapshot_name = State('input-snapshot-name', 'value'),
            select_project = State('select-load-project', 'value'),
            select_snapshot = State('select-load-snapshot', 'value'),
        ),
        prevent_initial_call = True
    )
    def handle_project_actions(
        active_project_id,
        **kwargs 
    ):
        # The buttons fire together, with no clicks, when they are drawn: act on the one clicked
        clicked = callback_utils.get_clicked_trigger()
        if clicked is None:
            raise PreventUpdate

        triggered = cast(dict, clicked.id)

        app_state = kwargs.get('app_state')
        app_state = json.loads(app_state) if app_state else {}

        rval = callback_utils.create_noupdate_return()

        if isinstance(triggered, str):
            match triggered:
                case 'delete-project-confirm-dialog':
                    project_id = kwargs['select_project']
                    if project_id is not None:
                        print (f'Deleting project {project_id}')
                        try:
                            active_project_id = delete_project(
                                app.project_provider,
                                project_id,
                                active_project_id,
                                app_state.get('model_type', 'default')
                            )
                        except Exception as e:
                            logger.exception('Could not delete Project ID: %s;', project_id, exc_info = True)

                        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                            'active-project-id',
                            'data',
                            active_project_id,
                            rval
                        )

                case 'delete-snapshot-confirm-dialog':
                    snapshot_id = kwargs['select_snapshot']
                    if snapshot_id is not None:
                        print (f'Deleting snapshot {snapshot_id}')
                        delete_snapshot(
                            app.project_provider,
                            active_project_id,
                            snapshot_id
                        )

                        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                            'active-project-id',
                            'data',
                            active_project_id,
                            rval
                        )
                case _:
                    print (f'Unknown trigger: {triggered}')

            return rval

        match triggered['key']:

            case 'rename-project':
                new_name = kwargs['input_project_name']
                if new_name is not None:
                    rename_project(
                        app.project_provider,
                        active_project_id,
                        new_name.strip()
                    )
                    callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                        'active-project-id',
                        'data',
                        active_project_id,
                        rval
                    )

            case 'create-snapshot':
                snapshot_name = kwargs['input_snapshot_name']
                if snapshot_name is not None:
                    s_id = create_snapshot(
                        app.project_provider,
                        active_project_id,
                        snapshot_name.strip()
                    )
                    callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                        'active-project-id',
                        'data',
                        active_project_id,
                        rval
                    )

            case 'load-project':
                project_id = kwargs['select_project']
                if project_id is not None:
                    can_load = verify_project_exists(
                        app.project_provider, project_id
                    )
                    if can_load:
                        if kwargs['session_id']:
                            app.project_provider.set_session_project_id(
                                kwargs['session_id'],
                                project_id
                            )

                        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                            'active-project-id',
                            'data',
                            project_id,
                            rval
                        )


            case 'load-snapshot':
                snapshot_id = kwargs['select_snapshot']
                if snapshot_id is not None:
                    created_project_id = load_snapshot(
                        app.project_provider,
                        active_project_id,
                        snapshot_id
                    )
                    if created_project_id is not None:
                        if kwargs['session_id']:
                            app.project_provider.set_session_project_id(
                                kwargs['session_id'],
                                created_project_id
                            )

                        callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                            'active-project-id',
                            'data',
                            created_project_id,
                            rval
                        )

            case 'new-project':
                model_type = app_state.get('model_type', 'default')
                created_project_id = new_project(
                    app.project_provider,
                    model_type
                )
                if created_project_id is not None:
                    if kwargs['session_id']:
                        app.project_provider.set_session_project_id(
                            kwargs['session_id'],
                            created_project_id
                        )

                    callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                        'active-project-id',
                        'data',
                        created_project_id,
                        rval
                    )

            case 'duplicate-project':
                created_project_id = duplicate_project(
                    app.project_provider,
                    active_project_id
                )
                if created_project_id is not None:
                    if kwargs['session_id']:
                        app.project_provider.set_session_project_id(
                            kwargs['session_id'],
                            created_project_id
                        )

                    callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                        'active-project-id',
                        'data',
                        created_project_id,
                        rval
                    )

            case 'delete-project':
                # Launches confirm via another callback.
                pass

            case 'rename-snapshot':
                new_name = kwargs['input_snapshot_name']
                snapshot_id = kwargs['select_snapshot']
                if new_name is not None and snapshot_id is not None:
                    rename_snapshot(app.project_provider, snapshot_id, new_name)

                callback_utils.update_property_by_id(
                    'active-project-id',
                    'data',
                    active_project_id,
                    rval
                )

            case 'delete-snapshot':
                # Launches confirm via another callback.
                pass

            case _:
                logger.exception('Unknown trigger when handling project selector action button clicks: %s', triggered)

        return rval

    @app.callback(
        Output("delete-project-confirm-dialog", "displayed"),
        Input({'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'delete-project'}, 'n_clicks'),
        prevent_initial_call=True,
    )
    def display_delete_project_confirm(n_clicks):
        if n_clicks:
            return True
        return False

    @app.callback(
        Output("delete-snapshot-confirm-dialog", "displayed"),
        Input({'type': 'action-button-ps', 'key': 'delete-snapshot'}, 'n_clicks'),
        prevent_initial_call=True,
    )
    def display_delete_snapshot_confirm(n_clicks):
        if n_clicks:
            return True
        return False

def mean_and_sd(var: FullLightweightVariable) -> str:
    """A Variable's mean ± SD, or its value for a constant, as the PSA page shows it."""
    if _is_constant(var):
        return _formatted(var, var.last_deterministic_value)
    return f'{_formatted(var, var.last_deterministic_value)} ± {_formatted(var, var.last_std)}'

def confidence_interval(var: FullLightweightVariable) -> str:
    """A Variable's 95% confidence interval, or `-` when it isn't known."""
    if var.psa_ci_lower is None or var.psa_ci_upper is None:
        return '-'
    return f'{_formatted(var, var.psa_ci_lower)}, {_formatted(var, var.psa_ci_upper)}'

def count_variables_with_different_distributions_or_sds(
    lproj: LightweightNewsegsProject, variables: Mapping[str, FullLightweightVariable]
) -> int:
    """The number of the variables shown on the PSA page whose groups have different distributions or SDs.

    Args:
        lproj: The lightweight project.
        variables: The Variables of the project, by id.

    Returns:
        The number of variables.
    """
    varids = dict.fromkeys(varid for lmm in lproj.metamodels for varid in lmm.variables)
    n = 0
    for varid in varids:
        group_vars = [variables[x.var_uid] for x in get_variable_groups(lproj, varid) if x.var_uid in variables]
        if group_vars and group_vars[0].psa_show and _differs(group_vars):
            n += 1
    return n

def create_psa_sharing_summary_contents(
    proj: LightweightNewsegsProject,
    varid: str,
    variables: Mapping[str, FullLightweightVariable],
) -> list:
    """Create what the PSA row's summary line shows: nothing unless there are several groups; otherwise each group's
    configurations and mean ± SD (or value), and `≠ distribution` if their distributions differ.

    The confidence intervals are left out, to keep the line short; the header and the editor show them.

    Args:
        proj: The lightweight project.
        varid: Id of the variable.
        variables: The Variables of the project, by id; it needs only those of the groups.

    Returns:
        The children of the summary.
    """
    groups = [x for x in get_variable_groups(proj, varid) if x.var_uid is not None]
    if len(proj.metamodels) <= 1 or len(groups) <= 1:
        return []
    focussed_index = proj.focussed_metamodel_index
    line = []
    for group in groups:
        if line:
            line.append(' · ')
        var = variables[cast(str, group.var_uid)]
        class_name = 'variable-sharing-group' + (' focussed' if focussed_index in group.metamodel_indices else '')
        line.append(html.Span([*_config_icons(group.metamodel_indices), ' ', mean_and_sd(var)], className = class_name))
    if distributions_differ([variables[cast(str, x.var_uid)] for x in groups]):
        line.append(html.Span('≠ distribution', className = 'psa-distribution-differs', title = 'The groups have different distributions'))
    return line

def create_psa_group_editor_contents(varid: str, active_project_id: str, project_provider: NewsegsProjectProviderInterface) -> list:
    """Create the PSA row's editor: the distribution, and a row for each group with its parameters, confidence
    interval and configurations.

    The distribution is shown once above the rows, or as a column when the groups' distributions differ. A constant has
    a Value, and no confidence interval. The focussed configuration's row holds its usual inputs; a project with one
    configuration has that row alone.

    Args:
        varid: Id of the variable.
        active_project_id: Id of the project.
        project_provider: Provider of the project.

    Returns:
        The children of the row's `input-group-editor` container.
    """
    provider = cast(FromDatabaseNewsegsProjectProvider, project_provider)
    lproj = provider.get_lightweight_project(active_project_id)
    groups = [x for x in get_variable_groups(lproj, varid) if x.var_uid is not None]
    if not groups:
        return []
    variables = {x.id: x for x in provider.variable_provider.get_full_lightweight_variable([cast(str, x.var_uid) for x in groups])}
    group_vars = [variables[cast(str, x.var_uid)] for x in groups]
    focussed_index = lproj.focussed_metamodel_index
    show_distribution = distributions_differ(group_vars)
    distribution_line = [] if show_distribution else [html.Div(vdc.create_psa_distribution_component(group_vars[0]), className = 'distribution-label')]

    if len(lproj.metamodels) <= 1:
        row = html.Div(_cells(varid, group_vars[0], True, False), className = 'group-editor-row psa-group-row')
        return [html.Div(distribution_line + [row], className = 'group-editor group-editor-psa')]

    rows = []
    for group, var in zip(groups, group_vars):
        is_focussed = focussed_index in group.metamodel_indices
        rows.append(create_group_row(
            _cells(varid, var, is_focussed, show_distribution), group, focussed_index, mean_and_sd(var), len(groups),
            className = 'psa-group-row',
        ))
    frame = create_group_editor_frame(varid, SUPERSECTION, _head(group_vars, show_distribution), rows)
    frame[0].children = distribution_line + list(frame[0].children)
    return frame

def psa_scatter_update(
    psa_data,
    cost_statistic: str = 'total_present_costs_discounted',
    benefit_statistic: str = 'total_present_benefits_discounted',
    show_proportion_ce: bool = True
):
    """Patch to update an existing scatter plot of a PSA with new results, without redrawing it.

    Args:
        psa_data: The results of the PSA; None to clear the plot.
        cost_statistic: The statistic used as costs.
        benefit_statistic: The statistic used as benefits.
        show_proportion_ce: Whether the plot annotates the proportion of samples that are cost effective.

    Returns:
        The patch (a Dash `Patch`) of the figure.
    """
    if psa_data is None:
        values = psa_plotting.psa_scatter_cleared_values(show_proportion_ce)
    else:
        values = psa_plotting.psa_scatter_values(psa_data, cost_statistic, benefit_statistic, show_proportion_ce)
    return apply_values(Patch(), values)

def psa_scatter_arguments(plot_controls):
    """Arguments of the scatter plot from the values of its controls.

    Args:
        plot_controls: The ids and values of the controls, as given to a Dash callback.

    Returns:
        Dictionary of `cost_statistic` and `benefit_statistic`, discounted by default.

    Raises:
        ValueError: if the discounting is not recognised.
    """
    discounting = 'discounted'
    for idx, id in enumerate(plot_controls['ids']):
        if id.get('key') == 'psa-primary-plot-discount-dropdown':
            discounting = plot_controls['values'][idx]
            break

    rval = {}
    match discounting:
        case 'discounted':
            rval['cost_statistic'] = 'total_present_costs_discounted'
            rval['benefit_statistic'] = 'total_present_benefits_discounted'
        case 'undiscounted':
            rval['cost_statistic'] = 'total_present_costs_undiscounted'
            rval['benefit_statistic'] = 'total_present_benefits_undiscounted'
        case _:
            raise ValueError(f'Discounting type not recognised: {discounting}')
    return rval

class RequestHandlerInterface(metaclass = ABCMeta):
    """Manages the creation, status updating, and deletion of (run) requests"""

    @abstractmethod
    def add_request(
        self,
        procedure_name: str,
        active_project_id: str,
        project_provider: NewsegsProjectProviderInterface,
        procedure_class: Optional[str] = None,
        config: Optional[dict] = None,
        triggering_request: Optional[registers.RunRequest] = None,
    ) -> registers.RunRequest:
        """Add a new request to the dispatch list.

        Returns:
            [RunRequest] The full RunRequest object for the added request.
        """

    @overload
    def get_request(self, request_id: int) -> registers.RunRequest:
        ...

    @overload
    def get_request(self, request_id: Sequence[int]) -> list[registers.RunRequest]:
        ...

    @abstractmethod
    def get_request(
        self,
        request_id: int | Sequence[int]
    ) -> registers.RunRequest | list[registers.RunRequest]:
        """Get one or more requests by id."""

    def get_active_requests(
        self,
        active_project_id: str | None = None
    ) -> list[registers.RunRequest]:
        """A list of RunRequests requiring management.

        Requests will either have status:
            - "AWAITING DISPATCH" (i.e. requiring a new run generated)

            - "AWAITING WORKER" (i.e. dispatched to await a worker, but without a run generated)

            - "PROCESSING" (i.e. with a run assigned and without having processed a completion of that run)

@singledispatch
def save_result(obj: Any, root_filename: str) -> str:
    """
    Fallback saver using pickle for unregistered types.

    Args:
        obj: The result object to persist.
        root_filename: Path/filename prefix (without extension).

    Returns:
        str: The full path of the saved file including extension.
    """
    filepath = f"{root_filename}.pickle"
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(filepath)), exist_ok=True)
    with open(filepath, "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump(obj, f)
    return filepath

def default_loader(filepath: Path) -> Any:
    """Fallback loader for unregistered or pickle extensions."""
    if filepath.suffix.lower() in (".pkl", ".pickle"):
        with open(filepath, "rb") as f:
            return pickle.load(f)

    raise UnsupportedFileExtensionError(f"No loader registered for extension '{filepath.suffix}' on file '{filepath.name}'")

def register_loader(*extensions: str):
    """
    Decorator to register a function to one or more file extension strings.

    Example:
        @register_loader('.parquet', '.pq')
        def load_parquet(path: Path):
            return pd.read_parquet(path)
    """
    def decorator(func: Callable[[Path], Any]):
        for ext in extensions:
            # Ensure extensions start with '.' and are stored in lowercase
            formatted_ext = ext.lower() if ext.startswith(".") else f".{ext.lower()}"
            LOADER_REGISTRY[formatted_ext] = func
        return func
    return decorator

def load_result(filepath: Union[str, Path]) -> Any:
    """
    Dispatches loading based on the file extension string value.
    """
    path = Path(filepath)
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"File not found: {path.resolve()}")

    ext = path.suffix.lower()

    # Value lookup in registry dict, falling back to default_loader
    loader = LOADER_REGISTRY.get(ext, default_loader)
    return loader(path)

def get_process_states(lmms: Iterable, process: str) -> dict[str, ProcessState]:
    """State of the process for each lightweight metamodel, keyed by metamodel id"""
    lmms = list(lmms)
    times = db_staleness.get_process_times([x.id for x in lmms], [process])

    with_results = set()
    unrecorded = [x for x in lmms if times.get((x.id, process), (None, None))[1] is None]
    if unrecorded and process in _LEGACY_RESULTS:
        result_type, get_component_id = _LEGACY_RESULTS[process]
        mm_by_component = {get_component_id(x): x.id for x in unrecorded}
        with_results = {
            mm_by_component[x] for x in db_staleness.results_exist(result_type, mm_by_component)
        }

    states: dict[str, ProcessState] = {}
    for lmm in lmms:
        changed_ns, last_run_ns = times.get((lmm.id, process), (None, None))
        if last_run_ns is None:
            if lmm.id not in with_results:
                states[lmm.id] = 'not-run'
                continue
            last_run_ns = 0 # Results predate staleness recording
        states[lmm.id] = 'stale' if changed_ns is not None and changed_ns > last_run_ns else 'ok'
    return states

def processes_affected_by_variable_swap(old_var, new_var) -> set[str]:
    """
    The processes made stale by a configuration switching from one variable
    instance to another, e.g. on changing how the variable is shared.
    """
    dsa = _differs(old_var.dsa_selected, new_var.dsa_selected) or (
        new_var.dsa_show and any(
            _differs(_try_get(lambda: old_var.get_dsa_value(bound, True)), _try_get(lambda: new_var.get_dsa_value(bound, True)))
            for bound in ('lower', 'upper')
        )
    )
    psa = _differs(old_var.psa_selected, new_var.psa_selected) or (
        new_var.psa_show and _differs(_try_get(old_var.get_std), _try_get(new_var.get_std))
    )
    optim = _differs(old_var.optim_selected, new_var.optim_selected) or (
        new_var.optim_selected and _differs(old_var.get_optim_bounds(), new_var.get_optim_bounds())
    )
    return processes_affected(
        deterministic = _differs(old_var.deterministic_value, new_var.deterministic_value),
        dsa = dsa,
        psa = psa,
        optim = optim,
    )

def indicator_feedback(lproj, process: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Class name and tooltip text for a process staleness indicator"""
    label = PROCESS_LABELS[process]

    if process not in _PROJECT_SCOPE_PROCESSES:
        lmm = lproj.metamodels[lproj.focussed_metamodel_index]
        state = get_process_states([lmm], process)[lmm.id]
        match state:
            case 'not-run':
                text = f'{label} has not been run for the selected configuration.'
            case 'stale':
                text = f'{label} results are out of date for the selected configuration; inputs have changed since it was last run.'
            case _:
                text = f'{label} results are up to date for the selected configuration.'
        return _INDICATOR_CLASSES[state], text

    states = get_process_states(lproj.metamodels, process)
    numbers = {state: [str(i + 1) for i, x in enumerate(lproj.metamodels) if states[x.id] == state] for state in ('not-run', 'stale')}
    messages = []
    if numbers['not-run']:
        messages.append(f'have not been run for configuration(s) {", ".join(numbers["not-run"])}')
    if numbers['stale']:
        messages.append(f'are out of date for configuration(s) {", ".join(numbers["stale"])}')

    if not messages:
        return _INDICATOR_CLASSES['ok'], f'{label} are up to date for all configurations.'
    state: ProcessState = 'not-run' if numbers['not-run'] else 'stale'
    return _INDICATOR_CLASSES[state], f'{label} {" and ".join(messages)}.'

def val_percent_formatter_factory(value_id, fraction_id, value_dp=0, fraction_dp=1):
    """Make a formatter of a value and a fraction in a dictionary, as `value (percent)`.

    Args:
        value_id: Key of the value in the dictionary.
        fraction_id: Key of the fraction in the dictionary.
        value_dp: Decimal places of the value.
        fraction_dp: Decimal places of the fraction.

    Returns:
        The formatter, a function of the dictionary.
    """
    fmt = "{:,." + str(value_dp) + "f} ({:,." + str(fraction_dp) + "%})"
    def val_percent_formatter(d):
        if d is None:
            return "- (-%)"
        return fmt.format(d.get(value_id),d.get(fraction_id))
    return val_percent_formatter

    """Make a formatter of a value and a fraction in nested dictionaries, as `value (percent)`.

    The ids are sequences of keys, followed through the dictionaries.

    Args:
        value_id: Key of the value in the dictionary.
        fraction_id: Key of the fraction in the dictionary.
        value_dp: Decimal places of the value.
        fraction_dp: Decimal places of the fraction.

    Returns:
        The formatter, a function of the dictionary.
    """
    fmt = "{:,." + str(value_dp) + "f} ({:,." + str(fraction_dp) + "%})"
    def val_percent_formatter(d):

        return fmt.format(recursive_get(d, *value_id), recursive_get(d, *fraction_id))
    return val_percent_formatter

def as_df(
    df: None|pd.DataFrame|dict,
    orient: str = 'columns',
    index_variables: list = ['variable', 'statistic']
) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    """Convert statistics to a dataframe indexed by the index variables.

    Args:
        df: The dataframe.
        orient: Orientation of the data in a dictionary.
        index_variables: Names of the index levels.

    Returns:
        The dataframe, or None if there are no statistics.
    """
    if df is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        if set(df.index.names) == set(index_variables):
            return df
        else:
            if df.index.names[0] is None:
                df.set_index(index_variables)
            else:
                df.reset_index().set_index(index_variables)
    return pd.DataFrame.from_dict(df, orient=orient).set_index(index_variables) # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue, reportArgumentType]

def present_single_scalar(
    data_list,
    value_name,
    variable_label,
    statistic_label,
    fmt='{:,.2f}',
    none_str = '-'
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    """Present one scalar of each configuration as a single row of a table, with a column for each configuration.

    Args:
        data_list: Statistics of each configuration (metamodel), or None where there are none.
        value_name: Key of the value in the statistics.

        statistic_label: Label of the statistic in the table.

    src_data = [x.get(value_name) if x is not None else None for x in data_list]

    odata = {f'config-{i+1}': [fmt.format(x)] if x is not None else [none_str] for i,x in enumerate(src_data)}

    return (
        pd.DataFrame
        .from_dict(odata, orient='columns')
        .set_index(['variable', 'statistic'])

def present_single_stat_per_row(
    data_list,
    table_name,
    variable_names,
    statistic_names=DEFAULT_STATISTICS_ANNUAL,
    fmt='{:,.2f}',
    none_str='-',
    variable_mapper: None|Callable|Mapping = None,
    statistic_mapper: None|Callable|Mapping = DEFAULT_STATISTIC_MAPPER
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    """Present statistics of variables in a table with a row for each variable and statistic and a column for each configuration.

    Args:
        data_list: Statistics of each configuration (metamodel), or None where there are none.
        table_name: Key of the table in the statistics.
        variable_names: Names of the variables to show.
        statistic_names: Names of the statistics to show.
        fmt: Format string for the values.
        none_str: String shown where there is no value.
        variable_mapper: Mapping or function from variable names to labels.
        statistic_mapper: Mapping or function from statistic names to labels.

    Returns:
        The dataframe; empty if there are no statistics.
    """
    valid_config_indexes = [i for i, x in enumerate(data_list) if x is not None]
    if len(valid_config_indexes) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    src_data = [as_df(x.get(table_name)) for x in data_list if x is not None]

    if isinstance(variable_names, str):
        variable_names = [variable_names]
    if isinstance(statistic_names, str):
        statistic_names = [statistic_names]

    extract_mi = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
        [variable_names, statistic_names], 
        names=['variable','statistic']
    )

    def extract_from_table(idx):
        tbl = src_data[idx]
        if tbl is None:
            subtable = (
                pd.DataFrame({'value':[none_str]*len(extract_mi)})
                .set_index(extract_mi)
            )
        else:
            subtable = (
                tbl.loc[extract_mi, ['value']]
                .assign(value = lambda df: df['value'].apply(lambda x: fmt.format(x)))

def present_paired_seasonal_stats(
    data_list,
    table1_name,
    table2_name,
    variable_names,
    statistic_names = DEFAULT_STATISTICS_ANNUAL,
    season_indices = range(len(SEASON_NAMES)),
    fmt='{:,.2f} ({:,.1%})',
    none_str='-',
    variable_mapper: None|Callable|Mapping = None,
    statistic_mapper: None|Callable|Mapping = DEFAULT_STATISTIC_MAPPER,
    season_mapper: None|Callable|Mapping = DEFAULT_SEASON_MAPPER,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Present two related seasonal statistics (e.g. a value and its proportion) in a table with a row for each variable, season and statistic and a column for each configuration.

    Args:
        data_list: Statistics of each configuration (metamodel), or None where there are none.
        table1_name: Key of the first table in the statistics.
        table2_name: Key of the second table in the statistics.
        variable_names: Names of the variables to show.
        statistic_names: Names of the statistics to show.
        season_indices: Indices of the seasons to show.
        fmt: Format string for the values.
        none_str: String shown where there is no value.
        variable_mapper: Mapping or function from variable names to labels.
        statistic_mapper: Mapping or function from statistic names to labels.
        season_mapper: Mapping or function from season index to label.

    Returns:
        The dataframe; empty if there are no statistics.
    """
    valid_config_indexes = [i for i, x in enumerate(data_list) if x is not None]
    if len(valid_config_indexes) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    src_data1 = [as_df(x.get(table1_name), index_variables=['variable', 'season_index', 'statistic']) for x in data_list if x is not None]
    src_data2 = [as_df(x.get(table2_name), index_variables=['variable', 'season_index', 'statistic']) for x in data_list if x is not None]

    if isinstance(variable_names, str):
        variable_names = [variable_names]
    if isinstance(statistic_names, str):
        statistic_names = [statistic_names]

    extract_mi = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
        [variable_names, season_indices, statistic_names],
        names=['variable', 'season', 'statistic']
    )

    def extract_from_table(idx):
        tbl1 = src_data1[idx]
        tbl2 = src_data2[idx]
        if tbl1 is None:
            subtable =  (
                pd.DataFrame({'value':[none_str]*len(extract_mi)})
                .set_index(extract_mi)
            )
        else:
            subtable = (
                pd.merge(
                    tbl1.loc[extract_mi, ['value']].rename(columns={'value':'v1'}),
                    tbl2.loc[extract_mi, ['value']].rename(columns={'value':'v2'}),
                    left_index=True,
                    right_index=True
                )
                .assign(value = lambda df: df.apply(lambda rw: fmt.format(rw['v1'], rw['v2']), axis=1))
                .drop(columns=['v1', 'v2'])
            )

        subtable = (
            subtable
            .rename(columns = {'value': 'config-'+str(valid_config_indexes[idx]+1)})
        )
        return subtable

    otbl = pd.concat([extract_from_table(i) for i in range(len(valid_config_indexes))], axis=1)

    variable_labels = _label_demap(variable_names, variable_mapper)
    season_labels = _label_demap(season_indices, season_mapper)
    statistic_labels = _label_demap(statistic_names, statistic_mapper)

    label_mi = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
        [variable_labels, season_labels, statistic_labels], 
        names=['variable', 'season', 'statistic']
    )

    otbl.index = label_mi

    return otbl

def event_and_date_records(
    data_list,
    event_name,
    event_label,
    event_value,
    event_value_formatter,
    date_label='On:',
    event_date='datetime',
    none_str='-',

    """

    date cells.

    comp_result = _comp_results(data_list, event_name)

    val_row = {'variable': event_label, 'statistic': ''}
    date_row = {'variable': event_label, 'statistic': date_label, '_align_end': True}
    for i, x in enumerate(comp_result):
        if x is None:
            val_row[_config_key(i)] = none_str

        val_row[_config_key(i)] = event_value_formatter(x.get(event_value))
        date = x.get(event_date)[:-trimdate]
        date_row[_config_key(i)] = {'label': date, 'start': date}

    return [val_row, date_row]

def filter_dsa_variables(dsa_df: pd.DataFrame, variables: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame:

def dsa_comparison_table(
    dsa_dfs: Mapping[str, pd.DataFrame],
    statistic: str,
    variables: Iterable[str] | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Table of one statistic of the DSAs of several comparators side by side.

    The variables are sorted by the largest interval of any comparator. A variable not varied by a comparator has
    no values for it.

    Args:
        dsa_dfs: DSA tables, indexed by 'variable' and 'statistic', by the label of the comparator.
        statistic: The statistic.
        variables: Labels of the variables to show; None shows all.

    Returns:
        The dataframe, indexed by variable, with columns (comparator, bound) for each bound of `DSA_BOUND_COLUMNS`.
    """
    frames = {
        k: filter_dsa_variables(v, variables).xs(statistic, level = 'statistic', axis = 0).xs('absolute', level = 0, axis = 1)
        for k, v in dsa_dfs.items()
    }
    frames = {k: v for k, v in frames.items() if len(v)}
    if not frames:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    order = _sorted_dsa_variables(
        [pd.concat({'absolute': v}, axis = 1) for v in frames.values()]
    )
    otable = pd.concat(
        {k: v.loc[:, DSA_BOUND_COLUMNS] for k, v in frames.items()}, axis = 1
    )
    otable.columns.names = ['comparator', 'bound']
    return otable.loc[order, :]

    label_df,
    statistic = 'net_present_value_undiscounted',
    variables: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    title: str = 'Lower and Upper DSA variation',
):
    """Draw a tornado plot of the results of a deterministic sensitivity analysis.

    The variables are sorted by the size of the interval of the statistic. The results may be those of one
    configuration, or the increments of a pairwise comparison.

    Args:
        dsa_df: Dataframe of the results of the sensitivity analysis.
        label_df: Dataframe of the labels of the variables.
        statistic: The statistic to plot.
        variables: Labels of the variables to plot; None plots all.
        title: Title of the plot.

    Returns:
        The figure.
    """
    plot_data = _dsa_plot_data(dsa_df, statistic, variables)
    if not len(plot_data):
        return _empty_dsa_figure()
    plot_data = plot_data.sort_values(
        ('absolute', 'interval'),
        ascending = False
    )

    label_data = (
        label_df
        .xs('variable_value', axis = 0, level = 'statistic')
        .loc[plot_data.index, :]
    )

    color_low = colours.SERIES_COLOURS[2]
    color_high = colours.SERIES_COLOURS[0]
    labels = plot_data.index.tolist()
    central_values = plot_data[('absolute', 'central')].to_numpy()
    lower_values = plot_data[('absolute', 'lower')].to_numpy()
    upper_values = plot_data[('absolute', 'upper')].to_numpy()

    hover_text = []
    for var in labels:
        label_row = label_data.loc[var].dropna()
        label_parts = []
        for key, value in label_row.items():
            try:
                value = float(value)
            except:
                value = value
            if isinstance(key, tuple) and len(key) >= 2:
                if isinstance(value, float):
                    if value > 10:
                        label_parts.append(f"{key[1]}: {value:,.1f}")
                    elif value > 1:
                        label_parts.append(f"{key[1]}: {value:.2f}")
                    else:
                        label_parts.append(f"{key[1]}: {float(f'{value:.3g}')}")
                else:
                    label_parts.append(f"{key[1]}: {value}")
            else:
                if isinstance(value, float):
                    if value > 10:
                        label_parts.append(f"{key}: {value:,.1f}")
                    elif value > 1:
                        label_parts.append(f"{key}: {value:.2f}")
                    else:
                        label_parts.append(f"{key}: {float(f'{value:.3g}')}")
                else:
                    label_parts.append(f"{key}: {value}")
        hover_text.append(
            "<br>".join([f"<b>{var}</b>", *label_parts])
        )

    fig = go.Figure()
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Bar(
            x=central_values - lower_values,
            y=labels,
            orientation='h',
            base=lower_values,
            marker=dict(color=color_low),
            name='Lower',
            hovertext=hover_text,
            hovertemplate='%{hovertext}<br>Lower variation: %{x:,.0f}<extra></extra>'
        )
    )
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Bar(
            x=upper_values - central_values,
            y=labels,
            orientation='h',
            base=central_values,
            marker=dict(color=color_high),
            name='Upper',
            hovertext=hover_text,
            hovertemplate='%{hovertext}<br>Upper variation: %{x:,.0f}<extra></extra>'
        )
    )

    fig.add_vline(
        x=central_values[0],
        line_color=colours.PLOT_EMPHASIS,
        line_width=1,
        annotation_text='Deterministic',
        annotation_position='bottom left'
    )

    fig.update_layout(
        title=title,
        xaxis_title = DSA_ALL_STATISTIC_LABELS.get(statistic, statistic),
        yaxis_title='Variable',
        barmode='overlay',
        template=colours.PLOT_TEMPLATES,
        height=800,
        margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=60, b=20)
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(autorange='reversed')
    #fig.show()

    return fig

def multi_tornado_plot(
    dsa_dfs: Mapping[str, pd.DataFrame],
    statistic: str = 'net_present_value_undiscounted',
    variables: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    label_dfs: Mapping[str, pd.DataFrame] | None = None,
    color_indexes: Mapping[str, int] | None = None,
    title: str = 'Lower and Upper DSA variation by configuration',
    centered: bool = False,
):
    """Draw a tornado plot of the results of the DSAs of several comparators, grouped by variable.

    Each comparator has a bar for each variable, from its central value to its values at the lower (hatched) and
    upper bounds, and a marker at its central value. The variables are sorted by the largest interval of any
    comparator.

    Args:
        dsa_dfs: DSA tables, indexed by 'variable' and 'statistic', by the label of the comparator.
        statistic: The statistic to plot.
        variables: Labels of the variables to plot; None plots all.
        label_dfs: Tables of the labels of the variables (the values at the bounds), by the label of the comparator.
        color_indexes: Index of the color of each comparator in `COMPARATOR_COLORS`, so that a comparator keeps its
            color whatever the selection; by default the order of `dsa_dfs`.
        title: Title of the plot.
        centered: Show the variations from the central value of each configuration (so that all the bars start at
            zero), rather than the absolute values of the statistic.

    Returns:
        The figure.
    """
    frames = {k: _dsa_plot_data(v, statistic, variables) for k, v in dsa_dfs.items()}
    frames = {k: v for k, v in frames.items() if len(v)}
    if not frames:
        return _empty_dsa_figure()

    order = _sorted_dsa_variables(frames.values())
    label_dfs = label_dfs or {}
    color_indexes = color_indexes or {k: i for i, k in enumerate(dsa_dfs)}

    fig = go.Figure()
    for comparator, plot_data in frames.items():
        color = COMPARATOR_COLORS[color_indexes.get(comparator, 0) % len(COMPARATOR_COLORS)]
        plot_data = plot_data.reindex(order)
        central = plot_data[('absolute', 'central')].to_numpy(dtype = float)
        lower = plot_data[('absolute', 'lower')].to_numpy(dtype = float)
        upper = plot_data[('absolute', 'upper')].to_numpy(dtype = float)

        values = {}
        label_df = label_dfs.get(comparator)
        if label_df is not None:
            try:
                values = (
                    label_df
                    .xs('variable_value', axis = 0, level = 'statistic')
                    .xs('absolute', axis = 1, level = 0)
                    .reindex(order)
                )
            except KeyError:
                values = {}

        def hover(bound):
            texts = []
            for var in order:
                parts = [f'<b>{var}</b>', comparator]
                if len(values) and bound in values.columns and pd.notna(values.loc[var, bound]):
                    parts.append(f'{bound.capitalize()} value: {values.loc[var, bound]}')
                texts.append('<br>'.join(parts))
            return texts

        for bound, bound_values, pattern in (('lower', lower, '/'), ('upper', upper, '')):
            variation = bound_values - central
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Bar(
                    x = variation,
                    y = order,
                    base = 0 if centered else central,
                    orientation = 'h',
                    offsetgroup = comparator,
                    legendgroup = comparator,
                    name = f'{comparator} - {bound}',
                    marker = dict(
                        color = color,
                        opacity = 0.55 if bound == 'lower' else 0.9,
                        pattern = dict(shape = pattern, fgcolor = 'white', solidity = 0.3),
                        line = dict(color = 'white', width = 1),
                    ),
                    hovertext = hover(bound),
                    customdata = bound_values,
                    hovertemplate = (
                        '%{hovertext}<br>' + bound.capitalize() + ' result: %{customdata:,.2f}'
                        '<br>Variation from central: %{x:,.2f}<extra></extra>'
                    ),
                )
            )

    fig.update_layout(
        title = title,
        xaxis_title = (
            f'Change in {DSA_ALL_STATISTIC_LABELS.get(statistic, statistic)} from the central value'
            if centered else DSA_ALL_STATISTIC_LABELS.get(statistic, statistic)
        ),
        yaxis_title = 'Variable',
        barmode = 'group',
        template = colours.PLOT_TEMPLATES,
        height = max(400, 120 + 40 * len(order) * max(1, len(frames)) // 2),
        margin = dict(l = 20, r = 20, t = 60, b = 20),
        legend = dict(orientation = 'h', yanchor = 'bottom', y = 1.0, xanchor = 'left', x = 0),
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(autorange = 'reversed')
    if centered:
        fig.add_vline(x = 0, line_color = colours.PLOT_EMPHASIS, line_width = 1)

    return fig

def psa_summary_comparison_table(
    summaries: Mapping[str, pd.DataFrame],
    statistic: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Present one statistic of the PSAs of several comparators side by side.

    Args:
        summaries: Summary tables of the PSA (from `psa.basic_psa_stats`), indexed by statistic, by the label of the
            comparator.
        statistic: The statistic.

    Returns:
        Dataframe with a row for each comparator that has the statistic, and the summary columns.
    """
    rows = {}
    for comparator, table in summaries.items():
        if statistic not in table.index:
            continue
        rows[comparator] = table.loc[statistic, [x for x in PSA_SUMMARY_COLUMNS if x in table.columns]]
    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns = ['Configuration'] + PSA_SUMMARY_COLUMNS)
    return (
        pd.DataFrame(rows).transpose()
        .rename_axis('Configuration')
        .reset_index()
    )

def psa_distribution_plot(
    samples: Mapping[str, pd.Series],
    statistic: str,
    deterministic: Mapping[str, float] | None = None,
    color_indexes: Mapping[str, int] | None = None,
    title: str = 'Distribution by configuration',
):
    """Plot the cumulative distributions of a statistic of the PSAs of several comparators.

    Each comparator has its empirical cumulative distribution, with a marker at its deterministic value.

    Args:
        samples: The sampled values of the statistic, by the label of the comparator.
        statistic: The statistic, for the label of the axis.
        deterministic: The deterministic value of the statistic, by the label of the comparator.
        color_indexes: Index of the color of each comparator in `COMPARATOR_COLORS`; by default the order of `samples`.
        title: Title of the plot.

    Returns:
        The figure.
    """
    samples = {k: pd.to_numeric(v, errors = 'coerce').dropna() for k, v in samples.items()}
    samples = {k: v for k, v in samples.items() if len(v)}
    if not samples:
        return _empty_psa_figure()
    deterministic = deterministic or {}
    color_indexes = color_indexes or {k: i for i, k in enumerate(samples)}
    label = PSA_ALL_STATISTIC_LABELS.get(statistic, statistic)

    fig = go.Figure()
    for i, (comparator, values) in enumerate(samples.items()):
        color = _comparator_color(color_indexes, comparator, i)
        x = np.sort(values.to_numpy(dtype = float))
        y = np.arange(1, len(x) + 1) / len(x)
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x = x, y = y, mode = 'lines', line = dict(color = color, width = 2, shape = 'hv'),
            name = comparator, legendgroup = comparator,
            hovertemplate = f'<b>{comparator}</b><br>{label}: %{{x:,.0f}}<br>Cumulative probability: %{{y:.1%}}<extra></extra>',
        ))
        det = deterministic.get(comparator)
        if det is not None and pd.notna(det):
            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
                x = [det], y = [float(np.mean(x <= det))], mode = 'markers',
                marker = dict(color = color, size = 10, symbol = 'diamond', line = dict(color = 'white', width = 2)),
                name = f'{comparator} - deterministic', legendgroup = comparator, showlegend = False,
                hovertemplate = f'<b>{comparator}</b><br>Deterministic {label}: %{{x:,.0f}}<extra></extra>',
            ))

    _psa_layout(fig, title, label, 'Cumulative probability')
    fig.update_yaxes(range = [0, 1.02], tickformat = '.0%')
    return fig

def psa_ceaf_plot(
    ceac: pd.DataFrame,
    labels: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    color_indexes: Mapping[str, int] | None = None,
    title: str = 'Cost-effectiveness acceptability curves and frontier',
):
    """Plot the cost-effectiveness acceptability curves of several comparators, and the frontier.

    Each comparator has its curve: the probability that it has the greatest net benefit, by the value of benefits.
    The frontier follows the curve of the comparator with the greatest expected net benefit at each value, which
    is the one to choose. A reference line marks a value of 1, at which the net benefit is the net present value.

    Args:
        ceac: The curves and frontier, from `psa.psa_ceac`.
        labels: The label of each comparator, by id.
        color_indexes: Index of the color of each comparator in `COMPARATOR_COLORS`, by id; by default the order of
            the columns.
        title: Title of the plot.

    Returns:
        The figure.
    """
    comparators = [x for x in ceac.columns if x not in ('frontier', 'frontier_probability')]
    if ceac.empty or not comparators:
        return _empty_psa_figure()
    labels = labels or {}
    color_indexes = color_indexes or {k: i for i, k in enumerate(comparators)}
    x = ceac.index.to_numpy(dtype = float)

    fig = go.Figure()
    for i, comparator in enumerate(comparators):
        name = labels.get(comparator, comparator)
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
            x = x, y = ceac[comparator].to_numpy(dtype = float), mode = 'lines',
            line = dict(color = _comparator_color(color_indexes, comparator, i), width = 2),
            name = name,
            hovertemplate = f'<b>{name}</b><br>Value of £1 of benefit: £%{{x:.2f}}<br>Probability cost-effective: %{{y:.1%}}<extra></extra>',
        ))

    frontier_names = [labels.get(x, x) for x in ceac['frontier']]
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x = x, y = ceac['frontier_probability'].to_numpy(dtype = float), mode = 'lines',
        line = dict(color = _PSA_FRONTIER_COLOR, width = 6),
        opacity = 0.35,
        name = 'Frontier (greatest expected net benefit)',
        customdata = frontier_names,
        hovertemplate = '<b>Frontier: %{customdata}</b><br>Value of £1 of benefit: £%{x:.2f}<br>Probability cost-effective: %{y:.1%}<extra></extra>',
    ))
    # The comparator on the frontier changes where the expected net benefits cross
    changes = [i for i in range(1, len(x)) if ceac['frontier'].iloc[i] != ceac['frontier'].iloc[i - 1]]
    for i in changes:
        fig.add_annotation(
            x = x[i], y = float(ceac['frontier_probability'].iloc[i]),
            text = f'→ {frontier_names[i]}', showarrow = True, arrowhead = 0, ax = 0, ay = -30,
            font = dict(size = 11),
        )

    if x.min() <= 1. <= x.max():
        fig.add_vline(
            x = 1., line = dict(color = _PSA_REFERENCE_LINE_COLOR, width = 1, dash = 'dot'),
            annotation_text = 'NPV (£1 per £1)', annotation_position = 'bottom right',
        )

    _psa_layout(fig, title, 'Value of £1 of benefit (£)', 'Probability cost-effective')
    fig.update_yaxes(range = [0, 1.02], tickformat = '.0%')
    return fig
